positive.text: This place was soooo good. Great food, great atmosphere and our waiter, Marcos was easily one of the best servers I've ever had in my life. We can't wait to go back to philly to stop in and get some more of the amazing gelato. This place is awesome and we'll definitely be back!

One of the most special and delicious restaurants I have eaten in. the Raviolis were exquisite and we had the goat cheese salad which was perfection. There is a great chef here and do yourself a favor and run to this wonderful unique Italian treasure.

Our meals were all delicious but oh boy that gelato. When I was picking out which type to try, they had mentioned that they won multiple awards. I have no doubt they won every away, it was to die for! The service was wonderful. All around a nice experience.

negative.text: I ordered takeout and only got 1 out of 2 items. I ordered the caneloni pesce and gran panna cotta and didn't get the panna cotta :( the caneloni was packed in a thin plastic container and bag so it arrived sad and cold. Maybe it's better for in person dinning..
I had a terrible, and I mean terrible waiter. Still miffed at the experience. The food is good however.

positive.text: Searched for the best Philly in Philly...and think we found it?! Not only was the sandwich amazing, but loved the fries as well! Def a gem- the service was fast and friendly, restaurant clean but had kind of an old-time feel. Def recommend!!

I live in the neighborhood and sonny's is my go-to, not for cheesesteaks (which are good), but for the burger. It's not a gourmet-avocado-truffle-$30-type burger. It's a basic burger, pick your toppings, get it with a side of fries and it is so good! Big portion, great price. I've always had great service here.

We loved our fully loaded cheese steaks! We got one provolone and one with cheez wiz. The Wiz is better. But the surprise hit was the pepperoni steak sandwich my son got. Also my little ones got hamburgers and they were really good. We liked these better then Jim's steaks....

negative.text: Horrible steak with horrible service. Eat this food only if you want to die early !!!

Horrible. Simply horrible. The worse cheesesteaks I've ever tasted. I hate to write reviews like this, but this place is an insult to Philadelphia, a place known for cheesesteaks. Should have trekked down to Pat's or Gino's....

positive.text: Love. Love. Love this place. Great Vegan/vegetarian options. Great prices. Serving portions are big enough but not too big. Old school cycling enthusiasts will enjoy the ambiance. The lack of plastic and single use items is awesome! Happy to have found a great spot with amazing food. Thank you!

The food is really fresh and tasty. Lots of veggie and vegan options but plenty of meat options as well. The juice and smoothies are delicious too. Lots of seating outside during nice weather and mellow dinning area for a relaxed experience. I had the burrito bowl "Santa fe" it was delicious! I highly recommend.

Their Crunchero quesadilla and the Highway to Khale salad is the best thing to EXIST!! Their smoothies are great and I love coming here for a healthy snack! Great service and I love the vibe of the restaurant!

negative.text: I usually get a bowl, but I got the bubba bouritto. It was not good to me. It wasn't wrapped well and was bursting with way too many beans. I had to get a tortilla out of my pantry to hold everything together. I'm quite sad
This is a 3 star eatery. Food and service were just ok. No one in our group finished their food. Worst part was we chose this place over Smee's Alaskan fish bar.

positive.text: Good seafood good portions. Good sushi nice platting seats are kind of small for a booth lighting is bright they need to dem it down a bit service was a little slow for me saki was bomb though nice sweet saki bread was so good delicious bread. Overall good seafood my salmon was amazing.
I love the sushi bar wonderful one of the best in town love Oceana restaurant everything is just fabulous great tasting food great service if I can give it a 10 I would

We had a family dinner and had Morgan help us with our time there. The food was great and Morgan was bringing stuff over before we even asked. She was fast, efficient, super friendly and made it a real pleasure. I recommend asking for Morgan. The manager Michael does a great job of keeping this place in check.

negative.text: I ordered a long awaited lobster roll. Very disappointing! bread was hard and stale and the lobster was not fresh.
Drink was nasty and side dishes were disappointing needed seasoning. Whoever the sushi and crab was good.

positive.text: The food was amazing- best coconut shrimp I've ever had. Vibes are great! Our waitress Mara took great care of us and was very friendly. Would recommend this place to anyone looking for great drinks and food with an awesome view of the beach!

We loved our family dinner here! The snow crab was excellent! 4 Way Shrimp was excellent for two in our party. The setting with the breeze and seafood was a great way to end our vacation. Mike was a great server. Island vibes....Key Lime pie was great! The Kids loved the ice cream too!
Great food - we ordered the Crab Cake, Coconut Shrimp, and Ahi Tuna bowl - AMAZING. Our bartender Steve was awesome - very attentive, great drinks, and super personable. 5/5 definitely will be back!

negative.text: Service was slow. Waited 30 minutes to be sat, after we ordered it took over 40 minutes to get our food. Food was ok. But it's all outdoor, no A/C so it was VERY HOT. Uncomfortable to even eat because it's so hot. Too loud. No soap or paper towels in the bathroom. Staff was friendly.
The limes didn't fit in the Coronas. There were other things too (ie. food over-cooked, awful service), but the limes didn't fit in the Coronas, guys.

positive.text: So glad I came here. The entire staff was super friendly and helpful. I had the fish tacos and absolutely loved them. Great flavor and a great portion size. One of my favorite fish tacos in town. Beer wise, I only tried their astro boy and really enjoyed it. I am excited to come back and try more!

This place wasn't quite 5 stars, but was good! My husband LOVED the fish tacos. My burger was good and they had a good kids menu too. Very family friendly for a brewery, lots of other families were there too. Nice staff. We'd definitely come back.

Service was awesome (they were really nice to my 2 year old) - beer was great, food was pretty good but not the best. Had family over and to get a nice warm spot outside with some good brews and friendly service was amazing!

negative.text: Terrible service combined with the worst hamburgers in creation make this restaurant a place to avoid. Plus the salads were awful: soggy and tasteless. Perhaps the beer they serve there is terrific; the food and service, however, are horrific! Should have gone to Chili's next door instead.
This place was horrible nasty food slow service and just an overall bad vibe. DON'T GO WAIST YOUR MONEY

positive.text: Loved this spot! Came here a few nights ago for the first time and sat outside. Loved the vibe, downtown Dunedin is really cute. Our server was super nice and helpful. I ordered a spicy tuna roll and some nigiri. Everything was really good! Definitely will be back to try more things off their menu :)
The BEST sushi place in the area! Best apps, best service, great atmosphere, and awesome ambiance, excellent sushi and entrees.

Best sushi place around! Pricey but worth it. My friend and I easily spent $90 including tip for just the two of us. But the rolls were AMAZING. If you have a little money to splurge, go spoil yourself with this delicious sushi.

negative.text: the food may be good but its the worst run and managed restaurant, covid to blame for hostess and reservation stupidity, yeah right, honestly food is good but half these people that leave the fantastic reviews wouldn't know good sushi if someone smacked them in the face with a fish
Spilt water on me multiple times. Long wait every time I've been there. Do not recommend not even that good. Disrespectful people work there.

positive.text: What a great experience. Super service from Austin! My girl and I shared the sweet potato pancake which was enormous! Super tasty! We enjoyed the Royale with Cheese burger and the hangover. The coffee was a local grind and quite good. Overall a great experience.
Great good for a great price ! This is Tampa's original burger joint that packs big flavor is a small plate. My server was super nice and made sure we were taken care of. I'd definitely come back.

Bright place. Great for kids! Awesome Coconut Creme Pie. My husbands Patty Melt was excellent. Fries are not to salty. Tea is good. Fresh lemon. Fast service. Clean. Sanitizer available. I had the cheeseburger an it was wonderful

negative.text: Worst food ever! Poor service, food is horrible. Burgers way over cooked. There were 6 of us and three were wrong. Fries were salty to the max and I like salt, onion rings were horrible. I don't know why I am giving them two stars. Should be minus two stars.

I usually don't write reviews but we stopped in here for some burgers. One of the worst burgers I have ever had. It was very hard and dry. Also ordered ranch for my salad. I told the server it didn't taste right and apperently the kitchen put horseradish in it. Would not recommend.

positive.text: An interesting local restaurant! The menu is interesting and has some fun options. The chicken parmesan was very flavorful and delicious. The Monday night drink special was great as their cocktails were delicious. Service was amazing and made the overall dinner experience even better.
Rotating menu & I have never been disappointed! By far favorite place in St Petersburg. Drinks are great. Atmosphere is upbeat & cheery. Staff is easy to get along with. Love love love.

the best pizza in town!! I always get the best service while i am there too. Mariah was my server two nights ago and she absolutely amazing and incredibly nice. I highly recommend this place. wonderful vibes and great workers!!!!!!

negative.text: This has always been such an amazing place but last night a group of us went there and it was so hot it made the meal and experience not worth it. We were all sweating at our table and were told that it was "due to the humidity outside". That is unacceptable. This is Florida. Fix your AC.
Who has a web site without prices? That's the kind of arrogance that will prevent me from trying it

positive.text: Didn't expect it but, Butcher and Singer was actually extremely good. Prime location and service was great. Each and every single item that we ordered was super fresh and flavorful. Staff are super nice and service is very fast. Honestly, Butcher and Singer is one of my favorite places!

5 stars!!! Drinks and food are absolutely amazing! One of the best meals at a steakhouse. The French onion soup is delicious. My filet was cooked to perfection. Our waitress convinced us to get the hash brown potatoes and WOW. JUST DELICIOUS. Don't pass those up! Can't wait to come back!

Definitely one of the best steaks i ever had.. Food and atmosphere was excellent.. The server Brian took really good care of us and explain everything perfect because it was my first time there, you should definitely request him. I will definitely be back!!

negative.text: Atmosphere is something you won't find anywhere else in Philly. 1920s-30s moody charm. The baked Alaska and Mac and cheese are to die for.

Was looking forward to coming to the establishment. Had the first reservation from open table. Was told to sit outside. When I asked for accommodation the manager had a nasty attitude. took my night to Fogo De Chao.

positive.text: This place was a hidden gem. Long lines, but great food. They even have someone taking your order for drinks while your waiting. I got the original tri tip sandwich and fries, and island blonde beer. They are dog friendly and have great outdoor seating options. Super cool area too explore too.

The most beautiful and atmospheric restaurant I've ever seen in California. This is not a Disney version of the old west - this is the real thing. Gorgeous setting, beautiful decor, good food, and good service. Great place to bring your out-of-town friends. Be sure to explore the various old buildings after your meal.

I don't really eat red meat, but they had tons of really good options. I ordered the Caesar salad, and the chicken was perfect. The meat was perfectly cooked and still very juicy. I would definitely recommend eating here.

negative.text: The hosts are the WORST. They are terrible at their jobs and have so much attitude. I don't think they could make it more obvious that they hate their jobs. Tri tip sandwich is meh at best. Bomb onion rings tho.
Jeff grandson 5 stars so sorry I typed in the wrong name a San Diego guest

positive.text: One word describes this place...FAST! Within minutes of ordering our food it was ready. The wait staff was nice and did well to keep us in drinks. The food was delicious, especially the corn beef hash. Best i have ever had. Great food, great service and decent pricing. Good place to eat!

Great service, great food and great company. Love my morning when I can get it to spend some time eating with my family. Definitely is our go to place for breakfast. It's big and spacious, excellent breakfast choices .

The best place for eggs Benedict! They hollandaise sauce is to die for! They also do really delicious and big skillets. I had their country fried steak, AMAZING! So juicy, crispy and tender and their gravy is delicious! Love the food and the service is always quick and friendly.

negative.text: Usually enjoy eating here but it's really dirty in the small dining room floor is disgusting. Table was Eden dirty. Staff clearing tables slamming dishes into the tub right behind me. Came in at a little before 1pm so it wasn't super busy. Food was okay. Not very impressed anymore.

Bad service and the manager is rude and racist. It took me 30 minutes to give me the order, and they did't give me the complete order, I went to the manager and she rudely told me that she could't fix it.

positive.text: Great local barbecue place! I love the location and the vibe. The outdoor seating is nice on a pretty day. The food is good, bbq chicken and the chicken and dumplings are my favorites. Good service, but If it's busy there can be a fairly long wait. Still Definitely a good place to meet BBQ loving friends / family.

Omg was this an amazing experience! I truly do recommend to come here and really anything on the menu would be delightful. The waitress was one of the nicest and funniest I have ever met. The food was delicious5/5 recommended

Been going here for years, I love it! Get the brisket and Mac n cheese!!! Always good beers on draft. Place is so so cute, we had my brothers rehearsal dinner here a few years ago and it was perfect. My only complaint is that service is typically slow/food takes a while to come out. Otherwise, everything is great!

negative.text: The food was good, sauces not so great, and none of the meals actually come with a side. For $17.50 I got just meat and was an extra $6 for fries. Also came in with over half of the tables empty and still had to wait 30 mins. Service was not great either.

My wife and I have visited this place several times. On Monday May 27 the serve was so POOR we actually left. We were seated but No one came to greet or serve us. My wife even noticed 2 workers looking at our table and having a discussion but no one ever came over.

positive.text: I like this mall. Have been going for a while only thing is be mindful of overdressing as it does get pretty warm in the mall but overall enjoy! It’s all good vibes at KP 😎
Great shopping area. Slowly but surely each location of the mall is opening up. Good friendly environment.

positive.text: Love it! Thankfully this place is still around. If you love that diner feel and comfort food in good portions that will NOT drain uour pocket...this place is it! Staff is always friendly, and the place is always clean and brifgt.
Excellent Food and Drinks. Best Hamburgers and Salads. Awesome Deserts. Good Wait Staff always helpful and friendly.
Nice diner food is good people are very friendly and they always come over to your table to make sure you have hot coffee there is water and your enjoying your food so great customer service

negative.text: Worst ! Dont bother going to this place! The food is horrible, the people in there have attitudes, the burgers are slightly bigger then white castle, and the prices are outrageous. positive.text: The place for special seafood lovers. Keep on going and love the improvements can wait to dine in and enjoy the great food and ambiance. Management and staff that love what they do. Thanks for keeping the doors open appreciate you all.
It's a WOW place for quality premium seafood well prepared by a great staff!!!❤❤❤
Great sea food and I love the out door seating right on the water. Good service friendly and polite 😊😊

negative.text: I really like this place, but last time I was there the service was bad and my Salmon did not taste good.
If you are into fried foods this is place for you. Limited menu options. I give staff 5 stars but as far as the desire to come back... no was not impressed. 👎🏻

positive.text: It was amazing. The view was perfect and the service was good. Our waiter "ADAM" was truly amazing because unlike a lot of people he treated us with respect and was very kind and fast. The food was very good and the steaks are amazing. I hope many people liked this place as much as we did!
It was great. I recommend the 2 mains and a side for 14,99. Great food, excellent quality and great service. Thank you again TGIF!
Excellent food and drinks! Don't expect "fast" service. Good food takes time to be prepared. Not an overly long wait, though. In the meantime, enjoy a delicious mixed drink 😊

negative.text: Horrible , everything is so disgusting . Steak (Filet mignon 8 oz) extremely small and disgusting. I will not be going back.
Not good at all they set us to a Table where the floor wasn't cleaned N The RESTROOM Was NOT CLEAN Also The FOOD WAS NOT GREAT !!!

positive.text: Perfect day for a perfect lunch!! Hah the NY burger whihc was great and the bacon & cheese fries were amazing, the staff was great and everything was clean and following COVID-19 guidelines
Always a great time and hardly have any complaints about the food but it is way better to go during the summer!!! Famous most delicious hotdogs 🌭 yummy
Delicious, nothing beats a Nathan's hot dog. Good food, great friends. Fun times before summer kicks off

negative.text: Food was good but the customer service was bad. Cashier was very rude and rushed us while we were ordering...made us forget to order a few things...
Ridiculous waiting time for a hot dog. 45 minutes! Completely un supervised.. Crazy waiting time for hot dogs. Wow really bad.

positive.text: Took my Fiend here to eat I have been here numerous times. They are always courteous, friendly and with a Smile. Food is Fabulous Service is Great and have built an Outdoor dining Platform where you can eat take off your coat and be comfortable in a Safe Environment. Love it🌟🌟🌟🌟❤
Excellent service. Good food. Reasonable prices. The Holiday menu is great for kids and fun loving adults.

IHOP is a go to place for Breakfast. Their waffles are best with the syrup. They do made to order eggs. Their coffee taste great. Don't forget to try the french Toast. There is usually wait time on weekends so be prepared for that, it's worth waiting. Enjoy your breakfast. Thanks Your Local Guide

Not so great.. I know this place is the place to go to with Family but the waiting time is crazy 1HOUR until the food was severed.

positive.text: L&B Spumoni Gardens was great Their Pizza Squares are as usual Delicious Delightful Spectacular magnificent Soft Crust Great Cheese Excellent Crust They got good Ice Tea

positive.text: Great place , great food and great service. I went there with a friend the food was delicious and fresh. Highly recommended. Also this place great for parties like birthdays and corporate.

I have a Lotta memories in this place I just love everything about it the food is super fresh delicious and tasty the staff is great decorations of the restaurants super cozy and Homie. My favorite dish is Plov 🤩

Really good food I really like the beef and lamb shish kebab their service is very great do you have a good soup lawman and service is excellent Will definitely be coming back and There take out service is great

Running a tip scam - they add 10% without telling you then suggest an additional 15-25%. These people steal from their customers.

positive.text: The best clam bar in Brooklyn !!! I been coming here for years an years. Try the stuff shrimp it’s amazing ! Great owners very kind an he waitress may you feel at home . Real seafood from the heart of Brooklyn .

I heard about this place years ago and it wasn't recently that I have the chance to visit it. I am glad I went. I did order the white clam sauce over linguine and WOW🤗🤗🤗 clam and pasta were tender juicy and full of flavor I can't wait to be in the Area again Highly recommend

negative.text: Wanted to still like place, but the food was not so fresh, most of the food had the flavor of the freezer. Sad, I miss the old Randazzos. Way overpriced.....

positive.text: Had an enjoyable experience at the front order area. A young lady named Carla took my order, with a special request and completed it the way I asked. But , the best part was that she smiled and was very pleasant. I think that her customer service was excellent and I wanted to say "Thank you".
They are fast, fair, friendly, patient, thoroughly caring, thoughtful, kind, and helpful all rolled up into one efficient and very effective industry. Their services are to be commended! Thank you!

This McDonald's is run superbly. The staff is always moving. The food is fresh. The bathrooms are clean. I really enjoy coming here when my son has practice at Lincoln high school. Great job to all those working here.

negative.text: I know it's McDonald's, but the little 14 year old at the register was just nasty and rude. I get it, you're 12, but no need for a nasty attitude because you can't listen carefully.

positive.text: Always great never disappointed! Food is amazing everytime we go back it's even better!!! Love this place❤

Delicious roast beef. Social distances set up & respected. Golden brown onion rings my friend had sweet potato fries cooked to perfection not burnt or greasy. I find the earlier you go the better. They also make delicious orangeaid fresh oranges in the drink no powder stuff. Price is average

Love this place. You can dine in now and they are COVID friendly so you can enjoy your food comfortably and with peace of mind. They also have parking in the lot so you can the food in the car as well. My favorite is their cheeseburger, cheese fries, and orangade.

positive.text: Great location, seating by the water side is just scenic, relaxing & makes u feel ur no longer in Brooklyn! great open air area on the street side as well, amazing Turkish cuisine menu items, super delicious food, music & live entertainment at night, hookah just makes the ambiance perfect! A gem in the neighborhood!

This place is excellent. Their kabobs are awesome. Hookah is fun. Reasonable priced. Babaganoush is yum. What a great time. Go with friends! Also they do something pretty fun for birthdays and celebration, I will post what I can for this. Go there in the summer and you sit on a deck on the water.

This is a wonderful place to visit in the middle of the day. You get a lovely seat by the window with the view of the bay. The staff is very friendly. Our waitor was very nice and made great suggestions. Highly recommend.

Delicious Food, beautiful view. Service is good and one of my favorite places to go to. Very classy and good quality food. Nice food presentation😀

The place is Fantastic. Great food. Great Roast Beef. Onion rings excellent. Great Wings. Staff is very Friendly.

The service isn’t as bad as the hype leads you to believe. Sometimes they are off and the roast beef can be kinda dry but that doesn’t keep me from coming back. The clam chowder and sweet potato fries are killer too.

positive.text: Food is just amazing. Go there at least thrice a week. Amazing yummilicious food..always piping hot.. yummmm... highly recommend ❤❤❤❤

Nice cozy place. The waiter was very kind and helpful. The food was great, definitely get the Saganaki cheese – fantastic. The prices were also reasonable and we got a 10% discount for paying cash instead of by card. Definitely a pleasant place to go for lunch or dinner.

I had the seafood Giovanni, my wife had a pasta dish rigatoni Sofia it was delicious the whole meal. The staff is great, drinks are excellent. Love the place I go just to see the gm Frank he is so friendly I recommend giovanni’s to all. You will not be disappointed.

negative.text: I was just served the worst Hawaiian slice ever. The pineapple was hard; the slice smelled so bad I couldn't eat it.

positive.text: Wow wow wow this place is amazing 👏 starting from the staff to the owner's thank you very much i really enjoy my time excellent food wow excellent time having fun from beginning to the end I really recommend this place to everybody excellent view excellent 👌
Celebrated my birthday with my family Beautiful view music 🎶 was nice delicious 😋 food great view waiter was really nice fast service 👌 will be making reservations again Thank you 😊

Ambiance was great, beautiful decor and music was lively but a little too loud to the point you can barely hear the person sitting next to you. Service wasn’t desirable when I went but will probably be a different situation next time. Still a nice place to go celebrate a birthday or special occasion 👌

negative.text: This is a beautiful place , but it is the worse service that I have in my life . I just entered to that place at 6.00 pm and they told me I have to leave at 8.00 They have a delay with the food and we have to eat rushing... pandemic will finish and business will continue.

positive.text: Wonderful service. Veronica was our server for the afternoon and. Such a great sense of humor and knowledgeable on all menu items. Blue Hawaiian was super strong. Just what I needed on a Saturday afternoon. Food was delicious. Great experience
Always great here, nice an cozy, may have to wait less then 30mins when it's real busy. The waiters are friendly, and they ready for a good laugh. It's a go to spot, for fun.
Awesome food, very welcoming employees, consistently good atmosphere. They charge fair prices and the food quality is great. Kudos.

negative.text: Service that date was long time waiting to get to a table the no bring not even water at least then u get a table soda take 18 minutes to get it unacceptable
Not very good acommodations for wheelchairs.the main entrance doors are very hard to open plus wheelchairs cannot come up to the sitting area . that's why I didn't come back.

positive.text: This is a great place the food is great the games are great they have great discounts the place is clean great place for little kids and older kids like 18 year old and older great place to just eat and spend quality family time and an awesome experience worth having.

Rude manager. I asked if he could open up another register and he said the line was not long enough for two registers. 30 mins later I'm still online and he walked pass, I mentioned to him I'm still on the line. He say rudely. "So"... I would never go back.

positive.text: This McDonald's Restaurant, Is super awesome. The staff here are so pleasant, and professional. The service is fast and your food is always hot, which makes a great combination. Tables and chairs are clean, and ready to go for the next patrons. I recommend this 👌 McDonald's Restaurant, great for adults and Children.

Love the team and how well they have catered 2 myself and lulabelle McQueen as by five star customer service including their respectable performance with the LoVe they have for us greeting us by a name whenever we visit. Displaying of teamwork and happiness is important. Thank you very much....
GREAT LOCATION LOTS OF PARKING, , FAST SERVICE AND ONCE AND A WHILE A NICE KIND SWEET CASHIER

negative.text: Fast food. Very dysfunctional, missing food ingredients in food order and ingredients added that I did not want and not attentive to timeliness. Multiple disputes with different customers at the same time. Negative attitude problem. The crowd coming here may be rowdy.
This place is terrible. Probably one of the lower quality establishments in the area. Avoid drive thru!! Wait times via drive thru can average 20 - 30 mins. Avoid this place if possible.

positive.text: (Translated by Google) Great place, great setting, singer, welcome good meal in more but it is worth the detour 👌 (Original) Super endroit, cadre au top, chanteuse, accueil repas bon dans plus mais cela vaut le détour 👌
The food was wonderful and so tasty. Love the vibe in the room and staff was very friendly . Would love to take family and friends there for dinner or lunch. ♥️♥️♥️

The best most, amazing, flavorful food you will ever have! The chicken is cooked perfectly, with a delicious crispy fried exterior. The waffles are delicious and fluffly. The mac and cheese will send you to cloud nine, with actual rich cheese. I highly, highly recommend this restaurant!

negative.text: My first time. The food was bland and cold. The dishes were dirty and not polished. The bar area was so stick it messed up my shirt. I think Ms. Silvia would be very upset. My aunt even said to me...this is a new Sylvia. Im so upset i didnt experience the original feel that i heard about.
Horrible! The food got me so sick. OMG three bottles of Petobismo.

positive.text: Great experience from start to finish. Our hostess Ebony was great. Our waitress Annalise was attentive, friendly and had excellent suggestions. The food was beyond good. Thankfully we had a large group so I got to sample a lot of the starters, each one better than the other. I will definitely be returning.
Great indoor dining experience, try cat fish and chicken, best food in Harlem , corn bread also great, great service, nice clean and well organized. Highly recommended.

Had a great night here! The chicken was fantastic - the breading is corn meal based I think so it’s a little different than the flour battered you’re used to. The Cornbread is phenomenal, and the deviled eggs were insanely good. Love the cool vibe, and great service. Def recommend for a night out with friends!

negative.text: I mean, its hard to get a table. But anything you order here is going to ruin your taste. I have not found a better chicken and waffle. Ever.
Rude staff, although place was empty no one waited on is until 40 minutes after sitting.

positive.text: Had a great time our waitress was so kind and sweet food was delicious thank
Our family had dinner at this establishment this weekend. Everything from the service to the food just EVERYTHING was outstanding!!! Can't wait to go back on Valentine's day 😊💖
Shakur was an amazing server she made sure we had a great experience she was attentive and the food was as expected the wine was good which she let us know all about overall a great experience there

negative.text: I asked for coffee the machine was broken I asked for a pina colada the blender was broken I went to the restroom the garbage was over flowing and several stalls had no Tiolet tissue. I was shocked and extremely disappointed because I've been to this location several times and never have I had poor service.
Worse Olive Garden Ever, My Alfredo Sauce Was Not Thick At All And Was Disgusting and Watery. Plus The Takeout Service Is Horrible, They Are Lazy and dont like to work

positive.text: Awesome n cozy mixed with GREAT southern food and the best sweet tea is a place I would be honored to visit time and time again!
The service was great the food was amazing I will keep coming here thank you for the great and wonderful service

Felt safe when they had security make sure everyone was following guidelines to maintain a good and safe experience for all. Besides that, the food is some of the best soul food I have had in a while. Try the mac n cheese and sweet-potatoes!

negative.text: No thank you the chicken was old and rubbery 😳😳😳😳. The mac and cheese was flavorless 🤢🤢🤢🤢. The yams were ok but overall no thank you. The service was the worst I'm not going back. 🙄🙄🙄😑😑😑😑
Food was horrible and prices are high. They are not the same as they was. Change the prices to reflect the quality of the food. I was very disappointed!!!!

positive.text: Had a great time. Food was good,drinks were cold, service was great. Jada is professional, knowledgeable, courteous, and patient. She recommended the truffle burger, which was delicious! She was on time when it came to getting us refills on our drinks. Harlem Tavern is great summer spot. Will be returning!

Music is good. Some nights there's a live DJ on deck. The food and drinks are on point. This is a cool hangout spot in Harlem. Great for meeting up with friends, a lunch, dinner date, casual dining, a good after work spot with a nice relaxed vibe.
This was my 2 time going there and I hope many more. Host was very helpful, food was delicious both times. Great drinks I recommend getting the drink called blue surfer I believe staff was amazing.

negative.text: What I did not like was small plastic cups for alchohol and being charged full price. That is totally ridiculous.

Nice staff but the food was terrible; I ordered a spicy chicken with blue cheese and lettuce wrap and it was like eating a block of salt and the drinks were too small for the price. First and last time going there...

positive.text: This place is the one I like best. I eat in a lot of restaurants but to this restaurant I keep coming back again and again. The crew is very attentive and the cooking they cook is so yummy. I am always happy to have a good meal in this place. I recommend this place with pleasure.

Great customer service even though it was quite warm during my visit. My server, Ashley had made some great suggestions & was extremely helpful. My meal was delicious! She was also training someone but that didn't stop her from giving us excellent service. Good food & good vibes. I'll be back!

Very professional including all protocols for covid-19 the food was amazing the service was great I will suggest anybody and everybody to go and Sample it ask for the sweet heart deal the place is awesome , Hands down excellent BBQ

negative.text: Horrible! Side are the worse! You will develop high blood pressure with the amout of salt they use!! I dont recommend!

Favorite smoked wings and deviled eggs. Outdoor dining can be dangerous on windy days. First ti.e since being here about 20 times that they served bad limes. Tap water tasted like it was sitting in an old cooler. Not cool!

positive.text: We enjoy to go out. Yesterday we came to this magnificent place which friends recommended to us. We spent a lovely evening there with superb meal and an efficient stuff and a great chef. We put this restaurant in our phone list and we will certainly return very soon. Highly recommended.

This place was heaving! But the atmosphere was amazing and the staff were helpful and awesome! The food.. was outstanding! I was so full but has to finish my food as it was too good to leave! And it was very reasonably priced!

This restaurant is my favored. I go to many restaurants but to this place I keep coming back again and again. The team is very attentive and the cuisine they cook is so delicious. I am always happy to have a good dinner here. I recommend this place with pleasure.

negative.text: Dry-rubbed hickory smoked Memphis-style ribs, smoked brisket, collard greens, baked beans, key lime pie and beer... what's not to love? I took off one star because the greens had way too much stem and my onion rings were raw.

Food was not as good as last month. The waiter was never around when needed. Had to wait over20 minutes for check. The greens had tok many stems this time. And the banana pudding had too many chunks of old bananas. I will give it one more try( go on Wednesday instead of Monday).

positive.text: Spencer Best waiter! Esteban so great, great he helped at our table. We had the amazing lobster, lamb chops, prime rib and steak so good. I ordered the Blue Moon Martini and James Bond Martini delicious. The meal and service was outstanding.

This place is okay. I love the atmosphere and the live music but I just expected so much more flavor into the filet mignon I had. The Roxy special sauce was a bit sweeter than expected. The drinks are great, especially during happy hour. Service is awesome as well!

The Roxy what can I say with a name as this. We had great time didn't have any food but just say and relaxed with a few drinks. We watched a couple spin with grace and style on the dance floor. The grand piano was magical and we were mesmerised as he pounded three ivories. And a red piano, perfect..

negative.text: I wasn't really impressed. But my companion Greg said it was his favoite? To each their own?
Could not be happier visiting this restaurant. Jeff and his team make the experience and the head chef cooks up some wonderful dishes.

name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken - Nashville West

positive.text: This is very good juicy chicken!! I like spicy, but not when it is overpowering, and found the medium to be the perfect amount of heat and flavor. The sandwich was amazing, the fries were good, and the potato salad was good too. The staff was all very friendly, kind, and helpful. I will absolutely be back!

Yes, the chicken is great, but the sides are even better. The Mac and cheese is amazing and is a must try. The black-eyed pea salad is unlike any black-eyed pea dish you've ever had--fresh and bright. The large plates are a great value, easily enough for a second meal. Definitely worth a visit!

My friend suggested this place, the chicken sandwich is delicious and perfectly seasoned and crispy! They give you sooo much food, the sides were really impressive- most side dishes are bleh since they're so focused on the main dish! We got the black eye pea salad and collard greens perfectly seasoned! Love it

negative.text: I'm confused by the hype. I was really looking forward to this, Nashville's signature food. The flavoring was good, especially on the sides. But the execution -- ugh. The chicken was tough and greasy. The grease flavor overwhelmed everything good about the chicken. It literally made me sick. Sad.

Got the Nashville chicken sandwich (hot!), and the pimento Mac n cheese! Both were to die for I stopped by Hattie B's for the first time on my way out of town and already want to go back! Definitely a place you need to go to while in Nashville!

positive.text: Every dish we have tried here is delicious! The best Thai food restaurant in the area. Erick is always super friendly and helpful in giving delicious recommendations. The outdoor eating area is very comfortable and nice.

Wow! Amazing We had the coconut shrimp Appetizer - I had the eggplant tofu basil dish, my husband had the garlic chicken and it was wonderful! Great dog friendly patio - thank you for that!! We had a wonderful dinner! Highly recommend!
Best Thai food in Carp. Always good service, always good food and I love the outdoor patio. Super cute place with great service. Food is great and not too pricey, casual attire always.

negative.text: I went here last night and I ordered the sweet and sour chicken and it was so gross and it didn't taste like sweet and sour sauce I took one bite and throw it all away it was a bummer!!!!
Got four entries. Didn't come with rice so ordered that too. $64 tab. $10 tip. Bad quality, tiny portions, little meat or shrimp.

positive.text: Fantastic! This place is excellent. All the food is amazing. Delicious sweet treats. Wonderful park area that is super kid friendly. Will definitely be back.

What an adorable place!!! Loved the Ambience, the beautiful outside seating, the cozy and warm fire pits and the delicious food! I got the Turkey burger with caramelized onions and avocados, OMG!! My taste buds were bursting with joy!! Love it and can't wait to go back on a warmer day!!

Stopped by to pick some food up for the beach. Food was great, we got fish and shrimp tacos. Fish was good, but shrimp stood out as the best. The back area looked very nice as well, it's right next to the beach, so great views everywhere.

negative.text: Grease bomb. I should have known better when they gave me ten napkins. They knew why. I had to shower after eating the fish and chips. Absolutely terrible. No. I asked twice if the tartar sauce was in the bag. It was not. This outdoor spot doesn't allow dogs. Bye.
Not dog friendly! Food is good. Local clientele harassed me. Cursed me out in the parking lot.

positive.text: I always have the best experience here. The food is sooo yummy my favorite is the blt salad or the chicken pasta !! The service was even better, Missy (our server) was outstanding!!! She took really good care of us and I'll definitely come back if she's our server again !! Love this place definitely recommend

Can be a little pricey but the food is good and the atmosphere is pleasant. Happy hour is a better deal and food is still good . I will come back and try to do happy hour mostly. Gets a little expensive during reg hrs.

I just enjoyed my best meal in Missouri. Everything I had at Firebirds was delicious! That wasn't the only thing that made this meal so Great. Our server Bella was on point. We never needed anything, and her charming personality just topped off the night. I will definitely eat here gain next time I'm in Missouri.

negative.text: Horrible service, or shall I say, no service at all. Walked in and sat at the one of the open tables. No one came to our table after waiting 15 minutes. We promptly left and went to P.F. Chang's
Bad cuts of beef coupled with unseasoned bartenders. This place is the Red Lobster of steaks.

positive.text: Their beer is simply outstanding! Many breweries have a beer or two that's good but The Vault is an exception, every beer is honest and good, nothing too trendy, just good beer! Food? Wonderful, service outstanding!! Love this place!

Vault Brewing is a super chill spot. Always some amazing beers on tap and great food. I'm a huge fan of the Buffalo Brown Sugar Pizza with prosciutto. All servers were super friendly and assertive. Only thing I wish they had was more gluten free items on their menu.
Great atmosphere! Bear Hug Oatmeal Stout is great!! Had there Brioche bread pudding! So good with the Bear Hug Stout! Great service.

negative.text: TERRIBLE SERVICE! Our waitrees kept getting our order wrong, we asked for a large beer, and got a small, and our waitress said "whatever"! She was rude and annoying. I asked for a milk a milk, and got SOUR milk! Worst expierience ever!
Food and service have gone way downhill in the past year. Staff are aloof - especially the host/hostess and bartenders on my last Two visits - Falling off My List Quickly

positive.text: Everything here was so so GOOD! Lobsters were cooked perfectly! Chargrilled oysters were flavorful. The lobster pasta with oysters was my favorite. Probably the best I've ever had. Customer service was very quick and friendly. Definitely coming back! I highly recommend!!
Great experience, great service! Our waitor Mohamed was great! All the workers were so sweet and helped make our daughters first restaurant experience great. Thank you!!

Can you hear the sizzle????? Best chargrilled oysters in the city!!! I could eat a few dozen, but limit myself to only one with a steamed lobster!!! Always great service and good drinks! This location always crowded so ability to make reservations would be nice,

negative.text: Worse meal ever! 3 out of 4 dishes were returned. Pasta dry, salad had jar dressing and lobster was the size of my thumb. Manager never gave her name but was rude, would never manage one of my businesses! Charbroiled oysters had no sauce. Over priced for a bad meal. Never will go back!

I order baked Salmon. Was 1/4 way in & it was RAW. Totally RAW. They took it cooked the same piece & put back on the same plate. CRAP is what I think about this service. Cheap A$$ restaurant. Totally disappointed!!!!!

positive.text: Always have a great time here. Usually very crowded, a good sign that it's worth the wait. Deli is amazing, great selection of wine and cheese. Bakery is so yummy, the single serve cherry cheesecake is the best. I've not had a bad experience and don't ever expect to. These folks know and love what they're doing.

Best best food ever and for the price. $7 for a huge meatball sandwich, $7 for a huge Italian sandwich. Plus can get bakery items and shop around for other great foods. Love love this place. We go every time we are in the area.

Amazing market and deli, sandwiches are some of the best in St. Pete. I really love the pasta and meals to go you bake at home. Great selection of Italian favorites, desserts, wine, and more. Highly recommend this locally owned Italian market.

negative.text: Me personally I don't care for this market. They are so ridiculous with the prices and the portions it's pathetic.
Enter at your own risk. People without masks, huge crowds. I had to leave immediately.

positive.text: Love this place. The food and atmosphere are awesome. Very clean. Makes you feel good to support a business like this. The prices are great, did I mention the awesome staff and menu? Love when my friends want to go here

We love these guys. We often order the fried chicken and love that we can pick what pieces we want. The potato salad is really creamy and good. Love their fries. Also like their brisket. The drinks are very delicious and the best price. We always get great service.

Great place to come have a good meal at a great price. Molly is a all star she was super attentive and always smiling. Besides the food being tasty I will definitely come back and hope she is working. One of the best service experiences I have ever had

negative.text: Food was great. Customer service lacked attention and skills. The place was dead too. One cook? Really. I understand it's slow season but that's crazy when a rush comes in and the server doesn't mention anything about the wait.

Poor service, took forever to get food, check, take our payment and return a receipt. Ordered the Mother Clucker and the the chicken leg wasn't cooked through. This was our first time there and we won't be back.

positive.text: Always Beautiful Delicious food! I Love this Place! Great owners and staff too! Everyone friendly and smiling! Great place !

Amazing food and great service at outdoor eating. Bolognese yum, veal parm, there were five in our party. Everyone loved their food and the deserts were delicious, especially the tartufa! Everyone was happy! Beet app was yummy. No complaints none

Amazing food and atmosphere. The staff were super nice and accommodating. Due to COVID, we wanted to sit at a corner table away from others and they easily accommodated our request. The outdoor eating is perfect due to the present pandemic. Complimentary post dinner shots were honestly the best thing of our meal.

negative.text: This was a favorite place pre pandemic but not sure what happened afterwards. Went there recently and all five of us came down with stomach distress (if you know what I mean). Afraid to try again.
The homemade pasta will make you feel ashamed of yourself for ever eating boxed pasta, and that's all you need to hear.

positive.text: Okay it was fresh, it was good, but I was hungry an hour later. These portions leave something to be desired, but man was it fresh! I ordered the trio with a cup of lobster bisque. The bisque was wonderfully creamy and delicious, the crab and lobster both sweet and full-flavored! You can't go wrong here!

Like this little spot. I love their ambience. Lobster Bisque is very tasty. Marvelous food. Not to mention, the service was awesome and the staff was really polite. Enjoy Luke's Lobster Rittenhouse and good luck.

Luke's!! The best lobster rolls in the city! ALMOST as good as the lobster rolls in Martha's Vineyard. Definitely a fresh catch and I love supporting sustainable foods. Sure the food is pricey, as expected, it's seafood. I tried a few of the menu items, the lobster rolls are my go to.

negative.text: Gave me horrible food poisoning on my last night in the city. Delicious food at a terrible price.
Terrible. I got the trio today.. It tasted dry. There were like two dots of mayo and they gave me the wrong chips. Not worth the $30

positive.text: It was great to find this place next to roasting company, they serve a generous Acai Ball, perfectly made avocado toast with reddish and pickles on the top, The crew is super nice and you can grab best coffee in town near by! Worth coming!

I visited this place during my Santa Barbara trip and I love it here! My friend and I had to go twice before we left. The place is very clean and most of the staff was friendly. I really love their bowls and avocado toast. This is a must-have when visiting SB! Thank you backyard bowls :)

This was the best and biggest smoothie bowl I've ever had!! The staff was so nice and the food even better!! I didn't think large was gonna be THAT big but it was and it was awesome!! They really put a lot of toppings on it too and that is always nice lol! I also added extra almond butter! Go here!! You won't regret it

negative.text: WORST place ever !!!!! Beware !!!!!!!!! Very BAD costumer service!!!!...if you gonna have your bowl or something you Have to wait until the employee eat and talk shit about their life style ...so you have to Wait however they want to server you..Fuck you All !!!!!!!!
The food was really bad I couldn't even eat it, it didn't look like the pictures. Waste of money not recommended

positive.text: I have only been once, but I liked it! I love the atmosphere. Got the rum flight and it was so cute & filled enough to get a nice little buzz lol. The food was good as well but I'd love to go back to try other things on the menu. I only got an app.
Super delicious food & great atmosphere. The guacamole trio is super fun and tasted fresh! The tacos were yummy. Would totally recommend!

I've been here at least a dozen times and never had a bad experience. Service is always good, food is always great. The guac is fresh, I love that we get plantain chips instead of just tortillas. The breakfast tacos are great. I'm in love with the yucca cake. I miss the $3 mimosas, hoping they'll be back.

negative.text: TRASH!!!! Terrible service and the food is not great at all. If you're a Hispanic this is the last place you wanna go.

Normally love. But waiter was horrible. Came to table twice and left dirty plates Never asked for refills on drinks. We had to ask him. Never asked if we were done or wanted dessert - just brought us the check

positive.text: 10/10, the pizza here is so good and authentic! Desano always provides the best service and pizza. It is definitely one of the best pizza spots in Nashville. They are practicing social distancing so well that we felt very comfortable the entire time! Will definitely be back soon and highly recommend to anyone!

Great hidden gem of a pizza spot! You order up at the front and then sit down at a table to wait for your pizza. The turn around time for the food is a little long, but wow it's worth it. It's one of my favorite pizza spots in Nashville. Great flavor, crust amount and toppings.

Best pizza EVER!! I know there are different styles of pizzas depending on what you are in the mood for but Desanos is always on point. The environment is pretty sweet too. Definitely good for a laid back date night.

negative.text: This is supposed to be the American pizza. All of our pizza was not fully cooked. We got the wrong order and it took over 10 minutes to correct. There was no water even after we asked. Service was poor. Would not recommend.

Lacks atmosphere. Pizza was mediocre. Staff unfriendly. Gave DeSanos another chance in Bellevue last evening. It was unorganized and chaotic. People are required to stand at the bar in a small area waiting for their pickup order directly in front of the condiment bar. Obvious frustration by many people.

positive.text: I really liked this place! Good vibes and great food! The ramen is also super good and the people are nice and willing to explain the menu if you're like me and don't usually get dine in ramen. 10/10 would recommend!

So much love for Raijin. Their ramen is incredible every time, super rich and delicious broth, and I love their ikageso appetizer. I miss the days of getting ramen here then heading over to the Loft for a movie. Hopefully someday soon!
Order food to go and got the Tonkotsu, was super delicious and portion is a great size! Service overall the best very friendly.

negative.text: I'm no ramen expert, but this place really opened my eyes to ramen. Whenever I want ramen, I go there. Starting to get tired of the same dish I get. I'm very opened to t try ing something new.
I got the veggie ramen and it tasted so bland, like sink water. If you want to waste money for bad food-this is the place.

positive.text: Delicious ice cream and milk shakes but for bacon lovers there is a special treat a one pound bacon sandwich'BLT' worth sharing the love. So make it a date or bring the whole crew you won't be disappointed!!!

Simply Amazing! Don't be thrown off By The Crown! It is still St. Louis's precious jewel! The food is fantastic and delicious! Their prices are fabulous! You must visit to Enjoy the experience! I've always visited; no matter where I am in the world! It has always been worth my trip!

This historic place has some good eats no doubt but be prepared to wait, sometimes there's a line to get in. First off, I love their BLT, probably one of the best if not the best I've ever had! Then there's their old school shakes, yummy! I highly recommend trying this place.

negative.text: This place is totally not worth the wait! It full of rude people and the atmosphere is not much better. I highly suggest wasting your time elsewhere.
BLT TO DIE FOR!!! The simplicity of their food will keep u coming back. I won't even mention the ice cream. 2 scoops coffee ice cream with caramel and those roasted pecans......Heaven!

positive.text: Delicious food, very friendly staff. AMAZING VEGGIES!!! Night time we had live music. We looked lost as we walked in and the owner was super friendly and showed us how this "line" works to get food. He was super friendly and did I say the food was AMAZING!!!

Great home cooked food and great service. Staff was incredibly friendly and attentive and everything we tried was delicious. Live music created a fun and entertaining atmosphere. Would definitely visit again if we come back to Nashville.

On of my absolute favorite restaurants in Nashville! Love the food and the people are amazing. It's really eat to see how they have been able to expand and change their store over time. A real home town success story! The roast-beef is my favorite! Literally could eat here once a week and never get tired of it.

negative.text: The only reason I can't give it 5 stars is simply because of the parking the restaurant is nice and spacious, the food is delish your good old meat and three plate, it's just the parking!! I hated that I had to pay for parking and there is limited spaces

Never got inside. It's $51 an hour to park in their lot on a Saturday. They don't validate if you eat there. There was a wait to be seated. We would have been $102 before we even ate anything. I would never go back.

positive.text: A very quaint but charming place with a great bar! The crêpes, savory or sweet, are to die for! They were truly better than any crêpe I've had in France. I loved the duck and pork crêpes! Flavorful with every ingredient intentionally used to compliment every flavor. And the fries are amazing!! You must get the fries.

Went for lunch and was happily surprised at how awesome this place is. They have excellent service, tasty food, friendly people. Highly recommend mussel Mondays! The frites are perfectly crispy, and the sauces have great flavor. They also have a nice beer list.

Loved this place. Pretty close to Belgian food but not quite there yet. Definitely the best frites and Belgian leigh waffle I've had in US. Greg, our waiter, is an amazing guy! We were very impressed with the place.

negative.text: Disappointed today. Food was fine but service slow and eggs served cold. Front door without air lock provide a blast of cold air with each customer who entered or exited.
Only thing I can say negative about this place is that I can't eat there every day... Food is amazing, so many different choices and the blueberry dessert is off the chart.

positive.text: Wow! Great food. I had the Cowboy burger... awesome. One child had the Turkey Club and loved it! Wife and other two children got the gluten free burgers and said they were the best they'd ever had! Fun environment. Definitely worth the visit!
I love Hi-Pointe. It is the best burger place ever! Can't wait to go back. And I love all the decorations. And makes the everything better! And the shakes they are awesome! I LOVE HI-POINTE so much!

Stopped here on a whim as it looked like a place my kids would enjoy. It was so good that we went right back the next day. The kids enjoyed burgers, hot dogs, and mac and cheese. Fries were amazing. Onion rings were also good. Everything we tried was great.

negative.text: They never get the order right. They made me wait 45 minutes. Keep bringing wrong order and forced me to take the wrong order. When I asked my money back, they were pretty rude. Don't go there.
Lazy people working here can't be bothered to read your order. Got a sad wet sack of shit idk if you could call it a burger.

positive.text: Love this place & thankful they were open yesterday for a great snack! Only sidewalk/patio seating available at thus time. My niece & I shared Flash fried kale & home made chips with vegan cheese. So good! Great service on a really hot day! I love a waiter who is happy to bring a few cucumber slices for my water!

I love to go to Layla. I have tried so many different foods there and everything is always wonderful. The staff is always super friendly and helpful and fun. The location is awesome. I love this spot!
So underrated!! The sandwich I got was phenomenal, the sweet potato fries were great, and the waitress was super super sweet and helpful! Also, their happy hour is really good

negative.text: At Layla in the grove they wouldn't seat us unless we had a reservation because they were so busy, place was empty. We left, made reservations and came back. No one else has been seated, still empty, the only people here. WTF???? What's going on here??? We are the only people here!!!!

Ordered on Postmates for the first time, paid for extra veggies with my hummus and pita and was given this. Typically there is twice as much pita, or you can get half and half for no extra charge. There was less food in each dish/appetizer than when I dine in. Disappointing.

positive.text: Terrific food. We loved everything we ordered, but especially the lamb kebab plate, vegetable sabsi, falafel, and the babaganoush. The owner is super friendly, gives a warm greeting, great recommendations and is a shameless self promoter, making the whole experience fun. Great place for vegetarians & vegans.
Best lamb in the world! Kabab Koobedeh is AMAZING and love love LOVE the dessert "awesome dude." I'm addicted!

This place was wonderful! The chef is charming and comes to introduce himself and check on every table. The servers were so nice and took great care of us. Last but certainly not least, the food is delicious!! Everything we had (traditional gyro, lamb kabab and appetizer combo) was so good! We will definitely be back!

negative.text: The worse restaurant I've ever gone in my life. Never ever recommend this restaurant. Outside the steak I got was burned and inside was completely raw. When I told the issue, instead of apologizing he told me you are rude and he made me to pay for food while I didn't eat it at all.
Food was good but I was disappointed that they forced me to pay 17 % tip without my permission. Leaving tip should be customer's decision.

positive.text: I love this place! I have had the Molle ribs and shrimp and grits. They were both amazing. This place make Brussel sprouts taste awesome. The calimari is the best around. The staff is great and the atmosphere is perfect. I highly recommend this place!

Food is always amazing as well as the drinks. We love coming here to relax at the bar for apps and dinner. They make a great old fashion and always have great bourbons. The dessert is also something you should save some room for. You will not be disappointed.
The food is insanely good, delicious drinks. Crispy, tender calamari, delicious lamb, and light perfectly battered fish with delicious fries, you truly can't go wrong by coming here.

negative.text: Casual farm to table option. The menu is a bit limited compared to other similar restaurants. And the service is a bit slow. The food is decent but nothing spectacular. My favorite menu item as the blood orange margarita.

Not really sure what happened to this place. Menu pretty much unchanged in a over year, out of the dinner special before 8, 30 min wait for drinks, steak served basically raw "because the chef didn't want to cook it medium" as per the server (but left on the bill). Last time for me.

positive.text: Queso is fabulous, always get the queso. My sister and I love coming here, but Brittany made this time particularly great! She is such a sweetheart, very funny, quick, and attentive. And if you love sweet tea, DEFINITELY get some!

Wow. If you are looking for a great Mexican resturant with great service and a staff and manager that care about your experience- come here! Great food. Great margaritas. Great atmosphere. Great prices- Come here! Make sure to ask for the manager Kevin! You will be back once you come! 10/10

Love love love going here! Food is always excellent & the friendly staff is a bonus. Fresh cooked food & an excellent variety of meats, veggies & other options on the menu leaving me anticipating the next visit.

negative.text: The service here was horrible. The waiter (Jess) was very impatient and the food was rushed. I will never be visiting this place again.
I was very disappointed by the food. It had absolutely no taste to it. It really surprised me because this place is always so packed on a Tuesday. I

positive.text: Beautiful atmosphere! Was truly a great German experience. Our server, Jane, was more than amazing! The pretzels come with the meal Also the chicken cordon blue fingers are delicious! Smiling staff is one of the many awesome qualities. Definitely recommend.

Love this place for the bier garden (great for live music !!) but came in today for a quick birthday celebration pit-stop. He had a Guinness and I had a deliciously gingery Moscow Mule. We split the provolone bread -- everything we delicious! The staff was friendly and the service was great.

Nice lazy Sunday, love the Biergarten here-quiet during the day but I'm sure it gets lively as the day turns into night. Good German good, live music, cold Hefeweizen-all the things you need in life. Matthew gave great service, I'll be back.

negative.text: Came here after a conference with lots of people. Many people in my party fell ill hours later after eating here. Food poisoning. Some couldn't leave their hotel rooms the following day to attend the conference due to being stuck in their hotel rooms with gastro issues. I won't be back, too risky.

Eher durchschnitlich. Schnitzel wurde nicht geklopft. Geschmack ok. Sauce sehr dunkel aber frische Pilzen. Rotkohl wahrscheinlich Dosenware. Spaetzle komische Orangenfarbe (Karotten drin?) und Salz gefehlt. Frischgezapfte Weihenstephaner war lecker.

positive.text: Such a good little place. Greek salad is awesome so cute inside. I also love their buff chicken wrap, so amazing. Their potatoes chips I'm pretty sure are homemade. Incredible. Sooooooooo good. You won't regret stopping in.
Breakfast was superb! Great coffee, great service, wonderful menu and our meal was terrific! Totally recommend and we will definitely return!!

OMG Yummy Great staff especially counter waitress! Love the peach iced tea $4 and worth every sip! I love the croissant French toast. They have a cannoli French toast is also delicious. It should be shared very filling.

negative.text: Went in yesterday and was told they weren't serving outside. This was a real shame and we left without eating. It's still COVID you guys and we're not comfortable eating indoors.
Such a bad services and the lady with glasses wanted to kick me and my kids out so she kept talking to other workers . This is so sad , I felt like I was eating for free like wtf!

positive.text: Amazing food. Great service. The corn beef hash is the Bomb. Waffles are delicious. Highly recommend. If we could give it my stars we would. Great for breakfast. Very family friendly. We even got some of the hot sauce to go.

This place rocks! Great food, awesome service. Very homey cafe in Carpinteria. Love this spot, just about everything is organic and very fresh. Definitely recommend this to anyone passing by or any local that has yet to pop in! Great spot.
Excellent breakfast, great service! Overall great experience! Highly recommend this place. We haven't been back for a long time and we are so glad we did! Best breakfast place in Carp!

negative.text: Slow. Overpriced. My order was incomplete. Missing butter and syrup for a waffle. Won't be back.
Disgusting cold food. Ordered takeout from this spot and it was gross. Service was quick and kind but food was just atrocious. Will eat at ihop next time. At least they have standards.

positive.text: Love this place! Obviously the wine is great, but the food is equally good. The chicken tacos are unique and so good! Highly recommend. The patio area is nice and we enjoyed a lovely evening.

Great atmosphere, great for brunch, dinner, great wines and fun food. Would definitely recommend. Patio is great when weather allows. Looking forward to going back soon! Love the wine and cheese pairing!

I've dated here many times and will continue. Food is so flavorful and staff is so, so nice and professional. Good for a fun lunch, good for happy hour and good for fun dinner. I've also been to wine dinners here and the experience has been amazing. I highly recommend!!

negative.text: Disappointing. We made reservations for this evening for 7:45. We arrived on time to be told that there aren't any tables available. It was going to be a 25-30 minute wait. Unacceptable that they allowed devour Indy participants over people's reservations. Clearly reservations don't matter to them.

Had brunch here with a few friends. The food was tasty, but the reason for an only 3 star review was the service. One of our friend's entrees was served 15 minutes after ours. The server did not apologize for the delay. The server also seemed more into flirting with a couple of women at another table than serve us.

positive.text: Had a group dinner here on a Monday night. It wasn't too packed, but just buzzing enough. The staff is super professional and friendly. The food was all very good. We tried almost everything on the menu and nothing disappointed. The cocktails were all very tasty and strong as well. I would highly recommend.

very cute spot! we came here on our first day in nashville and enjoyed their happy hour. the atomosphere was very nice, not too busy (which is good) i shared breakfast burrito with a friend and enjoyed it very much. very fulfilling the buffalo dip nachos were amazing!!!!

I love this restaurant! The food is amazing! I love that they use so many local farms. I also love that they are locally owned and operated and support so many local causes. If you are going downtown, DEFINITELY eat here! You will not be disappointed.

negative.text: Ugh everything was just so weird. We normally love deviled eggs and these were just odd. The chow chow really ruined them. The pimento cheese binettes were just to spicy. The carbonara was just ok. Way to many black eyed peas. Over priced and over rated.

Word of mouth sent me here. We were sat by the restroom hallway which reeked of sewage. Could also hear constant verbal abuse from the kitchen. When I asked my server what was happening she laughed. "It's so much harder being black here than being a woman."

positive.text: Fabulous food!! Simple but fresh and wonderfully tasty. We had heard that it was Julia Child's favourite Mexican restaurant... and it was easy to see why. The tacos were rich and satisfying and the beans were out of this world. Worth a trip to Santa Barbara just for that alone.

This place is so amazing!!! The best tamale i have ever had!!!! Highly recommend this place if you are in the Santa Barbara. The tortillas are hand made best tortillas i have had. Don't skip this place it's an experience!!!!!

not a super long line, but a 20+minute wait for food which is reasonable The food was pretty good, not exceptional, but I appreciated that evrrything was made there and then with fresh tortillas. The tritip in my tacos was a bit chewy, but tasty enough. Great service

negative.text: The wait is excruciating slow. Simply it should never take this long to order. I can only hope it is worth the wait but if you don't have the time pass this place up. Frustrating.
Good food but just so damn slow. You will be waiting at least 30-45 mins for your food.

positive.text: Love this place!! It's so beautiful!! I had drinks here with friends, so I can't say anything about the food- but this historic building and courtyard is a wonderful experience!! You feel like you are in a movie!! We walked upstairs and all around- just to soak in the beauty and enjoy this fabulous property!!

This place was great! From the person who seated us to the wonderful wait staff. Our experience was amazing. Came back a second night on our trip to New Orleans and it was just as good. The food was good, the service was fast. Staff was super thoughtful and friendly! Thank you! We will be back when in New Orleans.

The best hurricanes in the city! Super fun place and great service. Loved the large courtyard and being able to sit outdoors. They are excellent with Covid precautions. You can order drinks as long as you purchase a food order. No better combo than Cheetos and hurricanes!

negative.text: Worst hamburger I have ever had. A dry patty on a bun. Nothing else and not able to get our waiter to stop by the table. Horrible service ( if you could even call it "service"

I'm glad they're able to open back up, but I think they should put a note on their website that they have a very limited (4 item) food menu. We went over and struggled to find a table, had our Temps taken, and then there was 1 app, 1 burger, 1 kids item and something else. But they had a full drink menu.

positive.text: Dinner was fabulous, the steak was perfect, our waiter Bodie was absolutely fantastic, great Jazz band , overall great experience, and would definitely recommend this restaurant and would most definitely come again. Great atmosphere.

The BEST food, beverages and service! The ambiance was nicely cozy...romantic or great for business dinners. The wait staff is knowledgeable, friendly and provides outstanding service! If you enjoy martinis, this is the place for one of the best!

We have always loved coming to Chandlers and have had amazing service and sometimes just ok service but never had such a friendly, outgoing, delightful and energetic service as what Jessie provided to us. It was such a pleasure to come in tonight!

negative.text: Wow. Very rude and unprofessional wait staff. No thank you. We're guests of the hotel and we felt like we were not welcome.
What's not to like? Great bar. Try their signature 10 Minute Martinis. Top notch wine list and the food is wonderful.

positive.text: Fantastic food, great atmosphere, and my favorite Huckleberry cocktails. All good and fairly priced, nine of us in our party and drank too many cocktails!!!! Still only $30 each with tip! Great place. Great food. Great drink menu, I recommend the huckleberry lemon drop! Love this place
Great Drinks. Great service. An excellent place to take someone you love. Excellent food. Been going there for over 10 years and thank you for your support of the CF families we love you!!!

Matt is freakin awesome!!! I would recommend the lemon drops and bruschetta all the way!! they sat us as soon as they could and the entire staff was so friendly ! thank you to bardenay !! great time had by my entire party! very thankful :)

negative.text: If there was a -0 that would be the score. Completely disorganized. 20 minutes to get a menu and 15 no one took our drimk order and 10 minutes more we WALKED OUT. WE DROVE FROM CALDWELL TO DOWNTOWN TO GO HERE. WORST PLACE EVER!
Horrible service. Only received 1 drink during happy hour. Bartender made sure not to check on us until it ended. Drink was good, but service lousy! Decided to take our business elsewhere fir dinner.

positive.text: LOVE this place. It can get pretty crowded (and now I know why) during the weekends, but I usually end up having luck getting a seat at the upstairs bar. I love the fireplace and the cozy vibe. Great service, great food and great drinks!! Highly recommend!

Great drinks and fantastic food!! Had the catfish sandwich wow wow wow soooooo good perfect mixture of catfish, aioli and avocado(no slaw) but absolutely delicious!! Met up with friends and and a great time!!!

Party of two went for brunch Food selection seems limited compared to previously but the food we ordered were very good! I ordered stuffed french toast , it was hand down one of best ! And my friend ordered american burger which was very good too per my friend.

negative.text: Rude bartenders! Be careful if you leave anything behind they will steal it and tell you and it's not there! So short fat girl with the Philly attitude is specially rude even after a 35% tip she treated us like shit

Decided to "give it another try" at the bar last night. Sat for 10 minutes and was completely ignored while bartender and servers walked past us time and time again. Just looking to be acknowledged let alone get a drink. Not sure how you stay in business. Dead to me.

positive.text: Traditional eggs Benedict was on point. Home fries were super yummy. Also the bloody Mary's were simple but super delicious! One child had a philly omelette and said it was delicious and the side of fruit was nice and fresh. Also chocolate chip Belgian waffle was delish. No complaints. Will definitely be back.

Such a great beachfront restaurant! The atmosphere of the deck is great and so is the service. Also the food is delicious and amazingly fresh. They even have a pool area out back which is perfect for kids and even adults to cool down. Highly recommend the coconut shrimp, it's fantastic!!

It was such a good time! I went on Tuesday and I went by myself. I was take care of very well. They had really good live music and the food was also delicious. I didn't know what to order and the bartender suggested the tacos and wow so yummy. It's also a special on Tuesday. Taco Tuesday!

negative.text: Incompetent staff. Rude. They scream at you for no reason. They have no idea what's going on so obviously neither do your guest so figure it out. Multiple groups were leaving and complaining in the parking lot about it.

Susane, bartender, bad and poor customer service, lazy to do or use the blander, just she wanted to get out of the clock, "blander is not working" is like she said, food was so so no to much flavor, place is nice, nice view to the beach

positive.text: Great spot on the water for cheap beer, good burgers and appetizers with great entertainment! The open bar is well attended by locals and a very friendly staff! Awesome atmosphere with the bonus of great food and service! We try to stop here at least once every trip to St. Pete so I am able to be here 2-3 times a year!

Food was amazing!!! It looks a lil rough when you first walk in but don't let looks fool ya. Brought out fish in that we caught that morning. Cooked them 3 different ways for us to try. The fish was amazing!!! Best I've had so far. Girls that waited on us were very nice and helpful.

We went to multiple restaurants while in St. Pete and this was definitely one of our favorites! I got a burger that was huge and my girlfriend got a nice size Caesar salad. The prices were amazing! Wish we had gone there every day on our trip! Thanks for the good service and great food!

negative.text: Servers are rude. This can be a busy place at times but they either ignore you, tell you their too busy for takeout or kick you out of a table once you've found one. People are busy, I get it but this place has drunk waitresses and rude servers.
They fly the flag of racism. I'll pass on supporting ignorance. They fly the flag of racism. I'll pass on supporting ignorance.

positive.text: Tried to check out this place a couple of months ago but couldn't find parking and ended up leaving. I am glad we decided to try again. Had the best tuna tacos ever! My daughter had the grouper tacos and loved them. Our waitress was super friendly and the place had a nice vibe. We will be back.

Amazing service! We enjoyed a beautiful dinner after Sunset . Totally recommend the Grouper Oh our Bartender Tricia was so amazing and attentive her personality Great service and food Delicious food!!

Tricia out bar tender is the best! We are locals and she is just fantastic. Reliable, fun, happy, kind and knows her drinks. Our favorite is the freshly squeezed grapefruit vodka drink! We love this place! Juliet & Paul

negative.text: Awful service. Raw oysters were great but the rest of the food, all of it, was awful. The service was just contemptible. Unfriendly, didn't check back in, acted like he really couldn't care less. Never came back and we actually had to tally our total ourselves and leave the cash on the table.

Manager is coward and crew are thieves! Went back to get expensive sunglasses that we KNOW were left on the table and Sever cleaned up as soon as we left! Asked to talk to manager and didn't want to come out!

positive.text: Good food excellent service! I love the food I had rice shrimp and the shrimp roll is the best! It's clean and cool! Not too higher I love the food! I was alone go back!

An excellent place to eat from every perspective! Attentive staff, excellent menu, comfortable and very clean dining rooms and of course excellent food. Order from the weekday Bento lunch menu for great value.
Best Chinese food in town. The best lo meon, the best General Tsos, the best shrimp dumplings. This place never disappoints.

negative.text: Their dim sum is not good at all and took a long time. We ordered the turnip cake, it was very bad, ordered the fried fish, unacceptable...The walnut shrimp tasted bad. Service was bad. I would not come back again.
Our waiter bluntly asked us for more tip while we are on the way out. Very unprofessional And bad service. Will not come back any more.
