Sat us by the kitchen and it took 10 minutes for someone to come by our table to greet us and take our order. The food was cold and not very good. We ordered the Mexican Scramble and were very disappointed. First time there and we will not be back.

positive.text: Not a place to go if you are in a hurry but definitely WORTH THE WAIT. Delicious, fresh and lovely presentation. We are from California where fresh, local produce abounds. I didn't want any deep-fried or greasy anything by this time on our trip. Fully satisfied with this clean little delightful spot.

Wow wow wow. This little breakfast place just blew my mind. The food is all homemade and absolutely delicious. If you are a scone person, you must try theirs, it is soft and warm. The staff is very nice and accommodating. Our hostess Stacy was so so sweet and accommodating. Her sense of humor is great

One of the best breakfasts I've had! Definitely the best waffles I've had!! You could tell it was fresh and great quality. will be back when I come back to the area! & the ladies inside were super nice! :)

negative.text: Incredibly long wait for a table. Didn't seem like hostess knew what she was doing. Very slow to seat you. Food was average nothing great. We will not be back.
Service is terrible! There were two open tables. We requested the one by the window. We were told a large party was coming in. It was a table that sat four. We knew at that point we were not welcome.

positive.text: This place ROCKS! Amazing pizza, great location, and friendly service. I always enjoy myself here and it has only gotten better through the years. Also, Dave's responses to the haters on here are the best; keep at it Dave! Don't let those losers push you around.

Amazing pizza, enough cheese to feed a small army. Have never been able to eat more than two slices before being super full and happy. Pizza pairs perfectly with a day on the couch! Pick up tastes just as great as eating it in the pub.

I've never eaten here but Dave's clapbacks are worth 5 stars. I'm definitely making this my next dinner destination. Slow service noted, but the food reviews are fantastic so I'll clear my schedule to enjoy a proper pizza experience. See ya soon!

negative.text: This used to be my favorite place but yesterday was the worst experience ever. The pizza had no sauce and the cheese leaked all over the the outside of the pizza in the box. Sad to say this place isn't the same after they renovated.

WTF happened? The pizza is unedible the cardboard box had more flavor, the pie itself was so dense with soooo much dough you actually could not slice it the taste was that of cardboard covered with pepper! I loved Blackthorn years ago but now they are bad, I hope they can come back......geeeeeez that was bad

positive.text: Great food and great service. Definitely a great food find! Fajitas are amazing as well as burritos and tacos. Good atmosphere. We eat here about once a week now that we found it. One of our go tos for a good dinner.

Macho tequilas has one of the better chimis in town. It's in a bit of a rougher part of town but inside is very welcoming and you can say the same for the staff. Margaritas are good as well especially the flavored ones. The prices are pretty fair and I'd say the food is pretty authentic.

First time visiting this establishment. Great little hole in the wall! Loved Danny Boy's old school kitchen. Great service, and excellent food. I had the carnitas, and my wife had the enchiladas. Very, very, very good food! Definitely will be visiting again in the near future.

negative.text: Mediocre food especially for the price- burrito and a drink $15... for lunch?? Yikes Doubt I would return before trying one of the other 1000 Mexican restaurants in town.
Finding out a place isn't open, even after calling and having no voicemail notification is pretty unprofessional.

positive.text: Love this place! Great happy hour, awesome beer and cocktail selection. The food is delicious- my favorites are the whiteout pizza and the chicken caesar wrap! And, of course, the best part is the service: always friendly and kind, they really go out of their way to make you feel welcome :) Definitely recommend!!

Amazing place! Love everything there, yummy appetizers! Best Margaritas and of course Beer. Great service, everyone is super friendly and always make you feel good! I strongly recommend, been going there for years.

Love Love Love the SB Brew Co. Owners, Wayne and Michelle are both passionate about their business and are amazing at keeping both the front restaurant and back lounge a great experience. Perfect to watch sports game at and obsessed with their Boneless Wings and their homemade Raspberry Balsamic salad dressing!

negative.text: The worst customer service I've ever dealt with. Not only was our waitress rude, she was short and terrible at communicating. She only stayed at the table for a sum of 5 minutes total. Messed up our Groupon and then blamed us. She should be fired. Terrible customer service, won't come back.

Bad food. Really bad service. Our waitress ignored us most of the night and chatted with her coworkers constantly. The pizza was gross, almost inedible. The nachos were also terrible. Beer was ok. Won't be back.

positive.text: I have only visited once, but the time I went it was absolutely amazing. My husband and I were craving sushi and burgers, so we chose this place because they have both. I'm not sure how a restaurant can have the best burger AND the best sushi, but they did. The drinks were great too. Right down in CWE, perfect.

Drinks were expensive but delicious. The sushi roll tasted amazing; however, the rice was less sticky...and more mushy. Wasn't a huge deal, as the roll still tasted great. I was pretty impressed that the spicy mayo actually had a kick to it, unlike many sushi spots in town.
Great location. The staff was cool, quite pleasant. I had happy hour fried mushrooms, veggie burger & sweet potato fries. It was all delicious. Good eats

negative.text: If I want just a drink I'll come back and only sit at the bar. If I want food with a drink will not be back. Service was horrible waited very long for everything then had to ask for anything we need ex. Napkin, silver ware, water just the normal. Cool idea of a place but not super impressed.
This was the worst sushi I've had in awhile. The spicy tuna roll was gross and had a barbecue taste to it. Everything was kind of overpriced and the service was very slow.

positive.text: Awesome spot. Great atmosphere, great food. Salsa and guac were awesome. All the drinks we had were great. Our bartender Gabriel was as good as they come, great service and very friendly. Highly recommended and will definitely come again

First visit during lunch. Menu has great items. I tried the highly recommended skillet tacos. This is a great dish especially if you love cheese. Service was fantastic, Lupe was our server and was great. She made great recommendations and was very friendly.

First time checking this place out! Great decor and ambiance, amazing happy hour deals ($5 La Casa Margarita are great frozen margaritas), service was awesome. Really enjoyed the Flautas de Pollo as well. Will be hanging at this spot more often!

negative.text: These must be paid reviews - this is by far the absolute worst Mexican place I've ever eaten at. Our entire table with guest in from out of town were shocked at how bad, the food and service was. There is NO CHANCE I'll ever revisit this place again.
Food was cold. Everything was bland sizzling plate was cold & soggy, margarita tasted bitter. Worst food I've had in a while.

positive.text: Delicious Ramen. Good pricing.. great service awesome resturant. Definitely a unique place and overall a great place to dine n chat. Great place for those who are just getting into ramen. I do wish they had more options on the menu.

AMAZING FOOD! This place is a go to! I love their sticky buns. When the dinning room is open, it's an amazing little room and the service is always great. While being only take out for COVID they are still upholding their amazing customer service and delicious food.

I love this place it is always excellent - I love to try new things on the menu. This last time though I had the Miso Ramen and added pork and the pork buns. The pork in both dishes was cooked perfectly and the miso broth was both savory and salty. I highly recommend visiting if you are near and like ramen.

negative.text: No baby allowed ! Trying to make a wait list and the manager told us that we cannot bring our baby because of hot soup. Come on this is ridiculous policy that we have ever known. You are not the only restaurant sell ramen and hot soup. 5 people need to sit at the bar area. This is really bad experience

Sick place the food here is delish Really makes you feel like you're in a different place once you step in. Very homey atmosphere. My only complaint is that during busy hours it can get a bit crowded but everything else about this place is bomb

positive.text: Amazing ! Food was delicious! Oysters, clams and octopus appetizers for the table. Shaun was the best! Efficient and accurate. Filet cooked perfect to temp. Aquarium was a great view. Thanks for everything Shaun! We'll be back next time we're in town!

This place i was amazing with a big fish tank in the dinner area. Everything we had was good. Their deserts amazing! The birthday girl had sword fish which was sooo good! The service was great and the atmosphere in their was calming. Maybe because you can watch the fish swim. Overall a great experience.

We had Easter dinner here. The lemon pepper papperdelle was fantastic. We also had filet mignon, grouper and swordfish. All delicious. The organic greens salad was so delicious . We just had an excellent experience and Angela was so good at describing everything. We had a great Easter dinner here.

negative.text: Terrible food. Fish was dry and had a bad odor. I never have issues with food, I was in the military and eat everything. Would not eat here again. Tried the crab dip and it smelled rancid. The fish tacos were so dry that the fish crumbled and the BLT salad had sour dressing.

No seating unless you have a reservation. Wouldn't even let the kids view the aquarium without a seat in the "main" dining area. They want $37 for a steak in a seafood town. Rude. Walked out with other unhappy guests.

positive.text: Had a great early dinner at Iron Hill. Did not have reservations and was seated quickly. Greeted by our server and placed an appetizer order for the Brussel sprouts. Highly recommend! Food was delivered timely and was as good as it was presented! Safe spot for a lively atmosphere and good food!
Had some good beers and a great dinner here the other night. Scallops over risotto in a citrus sauce. Great atmosphere and a great place to get some great brews and food.

I love the fact that they had the Black is Beautiful beer. It is amazing with a very robust taste. They also make amazing crab cake sandwiches that are full and I do mean full of lump crabmeat. The fries are made in house and cut very thick. The chicken sandwich is also a good notable mention.

negative.text: It was busy and had the worst service ever. We wait so long for our waitress that the bartender brought us our drinks. Then I got food poisoning later that night... we went their for a birthday. The waitress handed the bill to the birthday guy... wtf

Waited at a table for 10 minutes. No one acknowledged us. When we asked for water the person who we askef stated they aren't a server. We waited and no one cared to come by table. No one. Place was not busy, we know why.

positive.text: Great little place for outstanding pizza, crust is outstanding with plenty of excellent toppings. The salads are also great. Very helpful & friendly staff. We keep going back for great food.
Nice ambiance. Great service. Fun atmosphere. Best pizza. Great place to celebrate the holiday on The Hill.
A great spot love to sit at bar... great toasted ravs and rustic pizza ask about the seafood pizza off menu but really great. Great value

negative.text: I usually get the tuttomare but tonight it was horrible. Only 1 shrimp few mussels and noodles were clumped together. Totally not worth the money. So disappointed
Beef ravioli was horrible. Worst ravioli I've had. There was hardly any beef in it. Serving size was way too small for the price.

positive.text: My first time going and it was a great experience. It was a really nice restaurant to check out after the quarantine that offered outside seating. Our waiter, Jesse was awesome. He made sure we were happy throughout the entire time. His service was great. The food was excellent as well.

It was my first time here, and I would definitely come back here. Carolina was our waitress and was absolutely amazing. She was very sweet, funny, attentive and a really welcoming person. Their food was great and their drinks were strong!!! Mojito pitcher is a must!

We enjoyed a good dinner on their outdoor patio on a beautiful summer evening. Our server was very nice and attentive. I had the huerache with chicken and it was very fresh and delicious. My family enjoyed the enchiladas and burritos they ordered. The nachos and salsa tasted homemade and very fresh.

negative.text: An hour and a half it took them to bring the food. It was freezing outside so we asked to take out the food, and the food was horrific. Bland, chewy, and horrible.
Awful. EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. Closed when website says their open (more than once). Awful service. Why I try again is only my fault.

positive.text: Best roast pork in Philly hands down! My sandwich was delicious with amazing flavor, great meat / cheese ratio, and the bread was super fresh and soft. Get there early because they sell out quickly. Take my word for it, you'll love it!
Passionate people who truly care about making others happy. Wish more business's are ran like this. Outstanding! Keep up the good work!

John is a class act, hard worker. But the Roast Pork is the best sandwich in America, Fact. James Beard Award Winner, Fact. Second Best Cheesesteak in Philly, debate-able. Never put Wiz on a Steak, FACT.

negative.text: Unacceptable service. Called a million times during regular business hours and nobody picked up the phone. No way to do online or in person orders so you're stuck on the phone forever until they get their act together.
The service today in 45 degree weather was horrible. I had to call them 18 times for the phone to be picked up and then needed to wait 40 minutes for a single sandwich. Not worth it!!!

positive.text: This place is AMAZING! My friends and I came here after a long hike, and we all loved everything we ordered. This was probably the best Mexican food I've ever had. The service was great as well. The restaurant is very cute. I will definitely be returning again whenever I am in Tucson.
Loved my outdoor patio dinner experience. Great food and wonderful staff. Tucson best and oldest Mexican restaurant!! Isaac thanks for the great service and suggestions of the menu!!!

This was recommended to me as excellent authentic Mexican food in Tucson. Absolutely special! We had the steak fajitas with grilled onions and peppers and the flavors were amazing! The drinks were great and service was perfect. Took home a piece of flan, smooth as ice cream. Wow!

negative.text: Our dinning experience was very disappointing. The quality of the food was very poor! Compared to previous visits, it's as though they are on a shoestring budget. Very sad they are serving the public substandard cuisine, Maria would be disappointed On the plus side the waitstaff was awesome!!

The tamales were mushy. The ground beef taco was odd because it was a salty hamburger patty not actual ground beef. My husband's chimichanga did not taste good either. The tortilla was tough to cut through also. Would not recommend this place!

positive.text: The sushi is ok. It's room temperature. You can get decent deals here. But my family seem to like it bcuz it's super close to home. Crab puffs are delicious just wish they had sweet and sour sauce. Calamari was delicious with lemon and their sauce they give to you!
Love this place. The all you can Eat is a bit expensive, but the buffet is a great option. The food is fresh and good. My girlfriend and I came in the morning and she loved it, so I loved it too!

This restaurant offers a great lunch buffet with great food and fresh fruit!!! The price is only 11,95USD per person!! And we can try all-you-can-eat sushi next time as well. The area is nice and staffs are really helpful. Nice to walk in and have a meal here.

negative.text: The service is horrible. Had to ask for wasabi and ginger 3 times before getting it. The table didn't even have bowls for soy sauce. The apps came out after the food. No refills on drinks. No staff comes by to check on you. This place is wack. Not going to set 50 bucks on fire there again.

Horrible.. just no. Squid was hella old, maybe even older than Tucson. How can you mess up fried food, especially Shrimp Tempura? This place! Extra charge for left over salty,soggy rice..$5. Never will I come back to this dump.

positive.text: The burger was so delicious that I forgot to take a picture!!! The fries were warm & seasoned almost to perfection but the burger I must say was very different and definitely delicious I will be definitely coming back when I get my craving for a delicious burger like that again!!!!!!!
One of the best burger joints in the StL! Had the Coyote tonight. Delicious! Perfectly cooked. Sat at the bar. Great service! Matt L took care of us - including making a flawless dirty martini!

Was in the downtown area and googled best burger, they did not disappoint! With social distance guidelines we sat at the bar and had a great convo with the bartender Matt. Service made the environment and atmosphere very comfortable. Perfect spot for a date night, recommend sitting at the bar :)

negative.text: Wanted to have a better experience here it just didn't happen. The burger was extremely salty and presentation was just bad. The onion ring and bacon looked old af. Shake was nothing special either and they didn't fill it all the way.

Matt at the bar helped us order killer burgers and picked the fire fried pickles. Go by and enjoy the food and drinks while having a lot of laughs! Matt's banter sealed the deal - new favorite place!! (As if the killer food wasn't enough)

positive.text: Staff is amazing and very friendly I love how it is safe place for lgbtqia+ and the food was amazing, my top 3 favorite pizza places for me. Also some top notch fresh ingredients. Very Eco Friendly.

Food is good; staff not so much. Parking can be a challenge but the atmosphere and ambiance are great. Fairly easy to get to and located near other attractions so a good way to kickoff or end your evening. Hopefully staff will be better when you visit. I've been several times and that is my biggest reason for 3 stars

I have always loved Pi! Their deep dish is the best of any other deep dish I have had. I also love the bada bing salad. They have a great variety of appetizers as well. Service is superb. Chris Sommers, you do a wonderful job!

negative.text: Horrible experience. Food was terrible, took forever to get our pizza, rude staff. All in all just a bad experience. Won't be back!

Worst pizza I ever had. You guys lost my business good job. Unbaked uncut tins of sauce no cheese and this was my second trip after first pizza was same. Told me 7:25 pickup on next one and got it at 7:55 only to eat this crap. Garbage can loved it.

positive.text: Nothing but great things to say. They had delicious gluten free options. The waiters were awesome and go above and beyond. Pancakes were great and gluten free! Enjoy :)

Must go. May be our new go to. Great employees and adequate space outside to enjoy the weather and delicious food. The usual favorites with a delicious twist. The seeded avocado is such a great added touch. Pancake may have been the best I've had in years. Thank you!

Really friendly server Coen was very welcoming and helpful. He kindly explained all the vegan options they had which was really nice for me. The food was delicious and the ambiance also great. They seem to be following COVID protocols so it felt safe with the doors open for circulation. Highly recommended!

negative.text: The host made an incorrect order twice. Portions we're small and overpriced for quality. Ham on my eggs Benedict was served cold. Would not recommend. As a Santa Barbara local I am very disappointed!

Seriously!! After reading the reviews also we went out of our way to find this place circling several times because of one way streets and parking was terrible. Finally parked and walked over to find out it is temporarily CLOSED! Dawn patrol you need to UODATE your info so that people are not wasting their time!!!

positive.text: Fantastic experience at Grace! Had the spice chicken tenders and Brussel slaw. Always thought it's hard to stand out with friend chicken, but this certainly tops my list. Also they have a great beer selection, highly recommend 4 hands brewery. Grace Meat + Three is really a great place!

Amazing food! They are super busy but the line and wait for your food doesn't take long at all. The catfish was cooked well and goes great with hot sauce. My friend got their mashed potatoes and those were really great as well.

Such a great place for weekend brunch and ability to have a beer just tops it right off. Love their hash but my favorite is their skillet cornbread. Decor is warm and homey while service is outstanding. They have enough tables for large groups so bring some friends!

negative.text: Disappointed. Food & service did not live up to hype. Chiken was greasy, cornbread dry. Not the best chicken I have had in STL. Delivery of food seemed disorganized.
I wasn't impressed with the menu choices or how it tasted which was disappointing. The food lacked flavor and seasoning. This place is too pricey to be a la carte and to have subpar food.

positive.text: This place was super cute, simple, and good. Shelli was AWESOME! She was super knowledgeable and helpful as I am gluten free. I love the simplicity of the menu. The steak was tender and delicious. I had a salad b/c the corn tortillas are rolled with flour. Can't wait to come back!

Awesome!! Just selected this place off Yelp and it was perfect!! We tried multiple different tacos, my favorites were the pescado and short rib special. The guacamole and salsa were definitely fresh and delicious too. It was quick and pretty inexpensive as well. Definitely making the trip back again!

Definitely worth the stop! The staff is super friendly and the food is great! The chips, salsa and queso are great to snack on while waiting for your food. My husband loved the torta and his tacos! My burrito was great as well!

negative.text: Always loved this place. But for about the last 5 months the food is always cold and not so good. It's really a shame. Is it new management? They just don't care? I don't know but taking a break fir sure.

We went here because it seemed it was always busy. And if it's busy, it must be good. Right? I wasn't happy, nor was my wife. I thought it was terribly expensive for what you got. There was plenty of parking. But, at least they have paper straws.

positive.text: I am now a big fan of this place! I was skeptical but wow! I has the bada bing cavatelli and they are delicious and so creamy. The experience makes everything better (it's a whole show) And please get the risotto with short rib. It is truly amazing! Amazing service and amazing food. What else can you ask for.

This place is amazing!! The food and service us impeccable We had the eggplant rolleto appetizer fantastic! I had a filet it was wonderful cooked perfect. My husband got the Hogfish Special it was amazing! We split tiramisu and vanilla gelato for dessert both were delicious!! Will be back for sure!

The food was delicious, the ambiance was nice and the customer was excellent. We both had a cocktail, both good . I got the carbonara, it was perfect. My friend got the braised ribs and risotto and it was amazing. The initial salad was very tasty . I will definitely go back

negative.text: It was awful, the service was incredibly slow. The bada bing pasta was so salty and rich, and a cheesy mess and not in a good way. The calamari had no seasoning and was dry and chewy. I was so disappointed based on all the reviews. I have no idea what went wrong.

Unlucky experience I hope where the meals came out wrong. But hey this happens they just make you the correct thing and your all set. Not here. They said it will take a very long time and didn't offer anything to compensate. Bad management hurts everyone. Wanted so much to like. Unfortunate.

positive.text: Delicious food, wonderful service, and great value. We had the chicken pakoras for appetizer (soooo GOOD), & tandoori chicken with saag for our entree, everything was amazing! Also I had the "Winter" cocktail, all I can say is WOW! That was the best cocktail I've ever had. This was a wonderful experience.

The best of Maneet Chauhan's restaurants. Some of the best Indian food I have had. My wife is not a fan of Indian food, but absolutely loved her lamb korma. My tandoori chicken in a tikka masala curry was perfect, tender, moist and a robust flavor. The staff was very helpful and attentive.

Holy yum! I normally try not to keep going back to the same restaurants even if I really like them but gosh darn it I might have to come back here! The short French onion naan? Okay, delicious. Had the chicken tandoori korma. Was amazing! Would definitely recommend.

negative.text: We were really excited to try this restaurant but were extremely disappointed. The food lacked flavor and was very oily. It was expensive and not at all worth the price. Service also wasn't great.

Very annoyed and. Disappointed. Website and a large banner on the side of the building promote open from 11.00 for take-out lunch Monday to Friday. Turned up at 12.30 yesterday to find the lights off and doors locked. Made a special journey for this. Not good customer service.

positive.text: Came here for dinner on a Saturday night! They were super accommodating to our group. The food was very good! I love crab and boy dis they have plenty of it! All the food our group had was very good. The service was great. I definitely recommend and they were following all the covid policies.

I was very impressed with my time at the buffet. The line to get in was very long but the food was definitely worth it. The service was great as well, our mimosas were never empty except for when we were about to leave. I will definitely say this buffet is on my list when I visit the city again!

Really like this buffet in the Atlantis. Meet friends there regularly on Mondays when they have two for one for seniors. The food is really good and fresh. Great turnover so the food is always fresh. Go early and enjoy.

negative.text: Couldn't believe they didn't have Turkey at the carving station on Thanksgiving! Pressed nasty stuff! Oysters tasted terrible! No carrot cake no pumpkin pie! When asked they said they were all sold out! This was at 2:00! Got to feel sorry for the few hundred people who were waiting in line as we left
4 out of 7 people from our family got severe diarrhea after having a lunch buffet on December 31st, 2021. Extremely disappointed.

positive.text: Driving through STL and from ATL, where we have some of the best BBQ, but this was awesome, had Beef Brisket with beans and slaw and if I could stay, ribs looked delicious. Would definitely recommend and go out of way again to eat here. Very friendly staff, quick, clean and worth every penny.

What an awesome experience. Food was fantastic. Ribs done perfectly. Burnt Ends were so great. Turkey is really really good but the pastrami may be the best on the menu. The staff is so friendly and proud of their work. Truly a place to try BBQ on STL!

We came at the end of the day so we got the "leftovers" but still really good! The sides are really good with especially the apple sauce. Baked beans are pretty peppery admittedly. Staff is super friendly and they offer a chill atmosphere.

negative.text: Pulled pork decent. But too $$ for the quality. They were too apathetic to put more ice in drink dispenser when it ran out. Very grimy sauce bottles. Just no ambience, and staff just added to the nothing special experience.
This bbq place is decent. They need to add regular bbq sauce, their sauces aren't so great. Overall, probably wouldn't go back

positive.text: I recently went to Eureka after the remodel and love the new look. It's so cozy and modern and fun. I also loved the live music and felt it adds a nice ambiance. The two weekends I went there the service was excellent and friendly. I would definitely recommend this place to my friends.

Had dinner and beers here with my family tonight and it was amazing! I had the jalapeño egg burger which was delicious. Our server Max was excellent and provided great service, such a nice guy! This is a great place to come for a fun and casual family dinner!
We came during happy hour. Great food and staff was super friendly! The happy hour food was amazing My hubby and I enjoyed everything we had.

negative.text: Food disappointed. Sorry Eureka, this wasn't your best day. Burger dry, small and sad, burnt flavor from the grilled onions. Poor fries, undercooked, pale and limp. Beet burger patty with a mushy texture, bed of arugula way over dressed and lemon vinaigrette too heavy on the garlic. Beer was tasty. Service was fine.

Absolutely horrible customer service. Was very unhappy with an order I placed and the response I received back didn't even attempt to make the situation right, just excuses. This establishment doesn't care about customer satisfaction one bit after they take your money, avoid this place like the plague!

positive.text: I LOVE BURGER UP!!!! Woodstock is my favorite! I am cheap so it's pricey for me but it's worth the price! They have slider lunch special which is a little more affordable if you're a cheap-o like me :) my gluten free friend loves their GF bun BUT it costs extra just FYI.

This is my second time at Burger Up and it didn't fail to disappoint. Great selection of burgers - from turkey, to bison, to vegetarian - and delicious regular and sweet potato fries. Definitely try (and mix) the house ketchup and mustard aioli! Awesome ambiance and friendly staff. Would definitely recommend!
LOVE!! Amazinggg burger, homemade and delicious dipping sauces. Great beer selection, a awesome vibes and atmosphere with great service. Wish we had a Burger Up in VA because this place was amazing!

negative.text: It was too oily , even the fried papper and fried onions inside the burger was toooooo oily. If you squeeze that it will spill the oil out. I pay $18 x 2 each for oil , and my husband ordered and it was oily too. My stomach had a very bad feeling after finishing this dish.
The burger patties were gray and overcooked. Not what I expect from $15 burgers. No more takeout for us!

positive.text: Great food! Great atmosphere! Highly recommend to anyone who loves sport bars and loves live music! (:
The best wings you will ever have - hands down. I recommend this place to all of my friends and family. Servers are super nice and the overall ambience is great!

One of my favorite places to eat. The wings are some of the best in the city with a great beer selection, tons of local choices! Great atmosphere and a great place to hang out and watch a game. 21+ so remember that if you have kids.

negative.text: Tons of beer . Best wings in the city hands down . Nothing but the best service . Every time I eat there I am blow away .
We drove 36 minutes to this place after seeing an ad on TV. It was packed and no social Distancing at all ! Every table was filled. The food might be great .... but the risk was too high !!

positive.text: LOVE coming here! Bazbeaux pizza is easily one of the best pizza places you can ever visit. Any pizza is a winner, but my favorite is the Margarita with gluten free crust. I know their Hawaiian and BBQ Chicken pizzas are also AMAZING! Can't go wrong with anything on the menu and I can't wait to come back!
OMG!! The Pizza tonight was WONDERFUL!! I mean perfect in every way. Perfect portion of toppings, perfect cheese and cooked to perfection. Great crew. It deserved 10 stars. I'm serious.

Great pizza, a little overpriced but I love the crispiness of every slice. Great flavor not too saucy or too dry. Really great lunch options! I would definitely return to dine alone, with family/friends, and food for children.

negative.text: Rude rude rude. That's all I have to say. The person at the register was the rudest person I've ever met and it's best to stay away.

Enjoyed the pizza I shared with my husband last night. It only sucked that I had to leave the hospital to pick it up because they won't deliver there. I even offered to meet them at the front entrance. Is there a fear of losing business if that information was stipulated in the delivery policy?

positive.text: Great place for beerz and friez!!!! Love the vibe and the staff. great location and great place to try new beer. Food is pretty good-- i recommend the comic fries!!!!

Bar food at it's finest. All fried and all delicious! It may tear your stomach up but it's still delicious. Recommend having the tendies coated in their fry seasoning! HopCat is great for draft selection and offers a lot of local and regional craft options

They call them crack fries for a reason. So darn good!! My husband likes all the craft beers here but they have other options if that's not your thing. I had a yummy hard cider on a recent visit. Fun place to hang with friends of catch up with bae.

negative.text: This establishment is the worst. If I could give negative stars I would. Waited over a hour for food. And it's messed up. Waiting another 30 min for my replacement burger to come. Everyone else finished eating. Guy who brought the replacement burger said he had dropped the first replacement and is compting the meal.
Food was great, management was horrible. Long story short one of the managers made my wife feel very uncomfortable with how he treated us! Won't be returning!

positive.text: We had a great family meal with a side of fantastic service. Everywhere is understaffed and I know one has to give some places a pass, but The server at Rippy's was awesome and fast. I forgot how nice it was to actually have great service and great food. I wish I could remember his name to compliment him further.

This is one of my favorite places when in Nashville! Tonight was our first time upstairs. 3 areas to this Bar & Grill with bands in each! Great BBQ ...I've always gotten the pulled pork, but decided to try the ribs. Wow, the Ribs are perfectly seasoned! Great Food! Fun, Lively atmosphere! Rippy's is a must!

The best ribs I've ever had. Onion rings are huge. It was absolutely delicious. Our servers name was Lisa, she was great. Very friendly, welcoming and informative. She made sure our drinks stayed full, what we ordered came out exactly right. So 5 stars all the way across. We were very pleased with all of it.

negative.text: Bad service Bad food Bad drinks Overpriced Killed the music in a bad way Not worth a wait No way

Beer SCAM - we had lunch here and they charged $9 per bottles of beer. Even the 12oz bud light bottles were charged at $9. Totally ridiculous. I would never go back here...no prices on the beer menu = SCAM

positive.text: Amy was AMAZING!!! She was the best server we have had in a while. She was super attentive and awesome! The food was also great! I recommend the Chipotle Shrimp Tacos :)

This is the nicest, friendliest UPS store! They never fail to be helpful and frequently go above and beyond. To a team member, they are efficient, competent and professional. A bonus for me is that they are about five minutes from home! Lucky me! Thanks, UPS store!
The best Mexican food in franklin! Best service by Daniel! Jalapeño margarita delicious! Best salsa we had to buy some for home! Go and enjoy yummy food and drinks!

negative.text: We had 6:30 reservation but did not get seated until 7:05,service poor,overpriced,my food came cold they took it back and stuck it in microwave ...NOT...could not get condiments....waiter went missing for 15 mins at a time,cleaned our own table off before desert....been here a lot ...worst I have seen......

Food is good but I can't recommend ordering for delivery. They canceled our order after an hour when it should have been showing up. The driver was at the restaurant so their poor operations wasted both my time and the drivers' time.

positive.text: This was a great place. The food was really good with fresh ingredients. Loved the atmosphere and the service was great. Happy hour has some good, delicious looking stuff. But we opted for the dinner menu. We ordered the grilled pork as well as the salmon. Both were very, very good. Loved it.

The ambiance was great and the food was even better! The Pan Seated Salmon Embraces Arizona Autumn was delicious and perfectly cooked. A wonderful fall inspired dish. Everything about our evening here was wonderful .

Came back here again for happy hour after two years or so. Much improved. The drinks, food, and service were all very good during happy hour. The happy hour Burger is a great deal! The ambiance outside was very nice. Will be returning!

negative.text: Bad tasting Caesar dressing. The side of $7 garlic fries were dripping and shiny with grease. When I asked our male server for new fresh fries he proceeded to explain that "they're fried so that's how fries are,,,,"
We were saddened to learn that DTK+C has closed for April. We understand entirely the desire to protect the staff in this difficult time. We'll be on the doorstep when Janos reopens! Join us!

positive.text: Absolutely love this hotel! Love Marriott and am proud to work for the company. Stayed a couple weeks ago and the staff was super welcoming and helpful with recommendations for food and what attractions to see. The I Love Christmas Movies was fantastic! Can't wait to come back each summer!

Beautiful hotel! Came by for a visit but I can see why people love to stay there. The botanical garden area was my favorite! So beautiful and it's huge! Lots to see and do within the garden. Had a great time walking around. They even had a bar near the falls we stopped at for a drink!

This place is super cute! Came when Christmas decorations were up. It's a mix of the Bellagio and Venician in Las Vegas. We ate at the pizza place and the pizza was huge and yummy. Would love to stay here sometime. The water show was cute and the plants were pretty.

negative.text: Stand around a hole with your family and throw your money into it. It will be more fun and you won't have to stand in line for hours to do it. Worst service on the planet. Insanely overbooked. No room to even breathe. We had been warned. We should have listened. Total shit show.
We were treated with complete disrespect by the staff. My wife was treated with complete disrespect. Our first trip to Nashville was ruined by this hotel.

positive.text: Meal was perfect, just as I asked! Haven't had my eggs cooked liked I wanted in a long time and the potatoes were just liked I asked! Wait may have been long but it was worth it. Brandy at the counter was most attentive and couldn't have been more charming! Love the dimples! Thanks for a great breakfast!

Always a wait. But you can always get on the waitlist. The food is amazing and the drinks are great. Our server was so good. She made some great suggestions for Gluten Free and even brought us some samples. Totally will go back!!

Wow ~ Once again the yelp reviewers were spot on! This was an absolutely fantastic breakfast place. I had the egg, tomato, spinach and cheese sandwich with potatoes and they were delicious. My husband had the French toast and he enjoyed it very much, our son had the breakfast tacos and he loved them! Great find!

negative.text: Carry out takes priority over seated dining and we sat a long time waiting for "our turn". The food wasn't that good. Not worth the effort.
The French toast was awful. I doubt they put it in the egg mixture at all. It was like eating bread that was slightly charred.

positive.text: This place is unassuming. You walk into what just seems like a bar and pub, but I'm always pleasantly surprised at the great service and large menu. I usually get the salmon and it's great. Also, while the front is noisy, the back is very comfortable. Good choice for different tastes.

Had my retirement party here this month. This place was AWESOME! Our waiter, Nick was outstanding. He kept everyone well fed and our glasses full! They were accommodating and so friendly! I will be back. Thanks for making the party fantastic!! I would give this place a lot more stars if I could!

Awesome bar on the loop in St.Louis! Amazing middle eastern hummus platter for only $10.99. One of the best hummus platters with delicious grilled pitta bread, red pepper hummus, Taziki, roasted peppers, lettuce, tomatoes and this great curry eggplant. Had a fun dungeon like door and dark pub vibe.

negative.text: Bad service. I sat at my table for 10 minutes waiting on a server as several other servers walked past. I walked out and went down the street to a different restaurant. The food looked good, but I never got to try it. They didn't even come and ask me if I wanted a drink.
Decent food. Water was hot and the server barely waited on us. We had to ask for another beer.

positive.text: Very hot lol but fantastic place for brunch! Food was okay but the mimosa bar was great and the outdoor games were fun! The aesthetics of the establishment were perfect for Sunday funday! Their retractable rooftop was pretty cool over the bar in the back.

The Avenue has such a great vibe. It's usually pretty quiet in the day time but on weekends they usually have a really good life DJ. They serve typical bar food that's pretty good and at reasonable prices. They have a great drink menu with a few large options great for splitting with a group.

Girls Night Out was great at this establishment. I had the buffalo wings and they were great with the R + R cocktail which was delicious. It was a nice vibe, my friend and I really enjoyed the night. I would definitely return for another night of music and fun.

negative.text: Fucking fried Oreos man. Bout to make a playa shit a fat log out. Other than that. Dope ass joint

Watever you do, never order takeout or Uber from this place. They cancel orders an hour after the orders are placed and show no sympathy at all for their customers. The food isn't that good and definitely not worth the aggravation. Very poor customer service and below average food.

positive.text: Love love love Los Agaves! Husband and I have been here at least a dozen times and we have never had a bad experience or even mediocre. Always great service! Delicious, quality, fresh food! I'm always leaving this restaurant in a very good mood. Thank you!

We had lunch today. Both ordered fish battered taco special. It was the best! The salad that come with it was amazing. Loved the orange salad dressing. Fruit on top was amazing. Beans great. Salsa bar fantastic. One of the best meals I have had in a long time.

Wow wow wow. We were in the area for a little getaway and had reservations at the higher end restaurants in Montecito and the food at this place was by far the best food we had all weekend. I wish this great little Find was in our town bc it was phenomenal and we would go weekly.

negative.text: I am a fan of los agaves and have ignored their bad reviews for years but today I was extremely disappointed. It took them 58 minutes to prepare a soggy, flavorless, and disgusting chimichanga. I've spent way too much money at this restaurant and I will never spend another penny. TRASH.

Ordered los agaves salmon salad for pickup. Which they had trouble finding order due to bad spelling of my name. Got home salmon was very raw not enough dressing very disappointing to drive back to the restaurant get in line for 10 mins after hard day of work.

positive.text: Fantastic food and ambience! I went with a large group, but it could really be good for a date as well. The classic margarita was amazing, and I had for dinner the filet mignon burrito. Our server, Mary, was super sweet, efficient, and light hearted! I will definitely be coming back soon!

The service here was great. We really liked our server, Damion, who was fantastic. He took great care of us and a really great first experience - we will be coming back. My hubby had the Cedar Plank Salmon and I had the Filet Chimichurri which were both great! Also, the sangria was amazing!!

Really was just delicious! CJ was the perfect waiter! He made excellent recommendations and his level of service was so professional! Thanks CJ and Red Mesa for a terrific dining experience. Try the strawberry shortcake! Everything on the menu is excellent, so try what you love! You'll love it here more!

negative.text: Three worst Service and food I gotten ever. We went to a dinner bday and the manager and hostess were horrible! They have zero customer service skills. Very sad. Will never step place there. I used to like it I have no idea why they declined their service.

I have to be honest, it wasn't the best food. It was very nicely plated and looked beautiful. The atmosphere was great as we dined outdoors. But both my hubby and I did not care for the food. I hate to leave these kind of reviews but it wasn't our favorites so unfortunately won't go back.

positive.text: Busy, full but luckily no waiting on Friday 6pm dinner. All tables were pretty much occupied bar tables and outside tables too. Food was great so not a surprise, with few drinks, it's easy to have good time with good food and good friends.

Love this place!! Was having dinner while visiting New Orleans. Love the inside decoration vibes and atmosphere. Food was delicious! Our party order 4 plates of oysters because of how fresh they were. Service was awesome (can't remember our servers name) she was so nice and sweet. Looking forward in coming back!

We had an amazing experience, the food was superb!! Our waiter was a Super Nice young man!! Sorry I forgot his name! First time having charbroiled oysters and they were delicious!! My Fiancee' enjoyed oysters for her first time!!! Highly recommend this place!! You will not be disappointed!!!

negative.text: The GUMBO from Acme Oyster House was DA BOMB!! #LovedIt Sorry I didn't eat here more during my NOLA visit.

We arrive there at 3pm Saturday, no waiting list at all. The fresh oyster is fresh but I do not why I feel uncomfortable . The oysters soup is really salty, I do not like it, and the grilled oysters is salty too.

positive.text: Man I love Portillo's and it was nice to see that there was one right by the Top Golf. Food was amazing as always, their hot dogs are so good. Line was short since it was a Wednesday afternoon but it was nice to have a short line. Staff was super friendly. Nice place to visit.
Excellent food and service! Great for groups or couples and the quality was excellent. Fast, high quality and staffed by friendly folks who seem to like their jobs! Great value for the whole family!

Had huge issue with order but they fixed it like a champ!!!! Customer service at first seemed like was going to be an issue but ended up being awesome. Manager la went above and beyond without me really saying anything. A nice change of pace that they saw it was an issue and said here let me fix it.

negative.text: Poor service and zero suggestive salesmanship!!! Complained online and never heard a peep. Fishers doesn't need any help being douchebag-ville!

1 person in front of us and we waited 30 minutes. Order was wrong. Ordered Italian beef & sausage, waist of money, only had a couple bites it was painfully dry. Fish sandwich cold. French fries are decent. Nothing good to say. Won't be back

positive.text: So good!!! Will definitely be back. Was super happy with everything. The fiesta salad was an awesome edition to the meal. The smoked wings with the sauces were really good!

Was there Friday night had the best dinner. Hog fish was dynamite. Great service even better food. Had lunch again on Monday Jesse was our waiter he was attentive and on top of his game. Once again food was terrific. Love love we will be back very soon.

Love Rumba. Early menu is reasonable. Fried shrimp delicious, salmon delicious. Pleasant, personable servers -- ask for Hugo! Always nice. Outside dining is quite comfortable, tables are (social-distance) spaced, fans and umbrellas for shade kept us cool, even at 3 pm. Go now.

negative.text: Awful just awful. Wait staff was rude. Busy for no reason. The food was not great. Steak was over cooked.

Awful is the only word for this place. I decided to go here because the parking lot is always full. Maybe it's the staff's cars. My burger meat tasted off as in rotten undertones to it. My buddy's food was not rotten but was too offensive to eat.

name: Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant - Town & Country

positive.text: A great time!! We did a wine tasting with our great friends then enjoyed a fantastic dinner. We signed up for the cub and can't wait to visit again!! Great food and great service!!

Excellent service, great food and good times! Had a great Sunday experience with friends. The drinks are excellent and Sir Ron was our waiter. We had the soy ginger salmon, Brussel sprouts, short ribs and a great number of appetizers.

I really love the bread they serve first! It's delicious! But I need to be careful tonto eat too much and be full by the time my meal arrives... I love the gnocchi! It's so tasty! I like it so much that I never tried another entree... Good atmosphere! Forgoing with families, asa couples or with friends

negative.text: I was disappointed the last 2 times I've gone. The food didn't taste as good as the first time I dined there. I wondered how many chef changes they've had since May 2019?
Food is just so so, very expensive for what is offered. Restaurant is very open and loud, disappointing.

positive.text: Dylan was an amazing server he told us about all the specials there and recommended the best food!!! He was so nice and took such good care of us. If you go to rock fire grill definitely look for Dylan because he's the best. 10/10 wings impeccable service beautiful talented gorgeous showstopping
Super cool, laid back staff. They're very nice and contribute to the friendly environemny. Beautiful outdoor seating. Food is great and is set at a great price. Super tasty and fast service as well!

This place is awesome! We were visiting and looking for a fun Santa Barbara experience. This is the place for exceptional burgers! Staff is super friendly, place is clean and food is delicious!! Easy to get to with free parking.

negative.text: I don't know if the quality of food has gone down because of covid but I won't be going back. I don't see how this place has 4+ stars. The burger was ehhh, and the wings were gross . The wings were chewy and had no flavor. Very disappointed.
Place was a dump and smelled bad. Food was not good. Wings were all batter no chicken. Won't be going back.

positive.text: Deanie's was our first meal after arriving in NOLA on a Thursday night. It was lively and bustling. There seemed to be a good mix of locals and tourists. The portions were huge and delicious! I wish we had more than 3 people in our party to try more dishes. I definitely recommend for a fun and tasty evening.

I had the best meal my entire vacation at this place. The freshest seafood, biggest and best oysters, and great service even though it was the evening of Mardi Gras at 9:30pm when we were there. Highly recommend their long islands as an alternative to the super sugary cocktails that are so popular in the area.

The bbq shrimp was great! Crab salad was great too! It was mostly crab lol. Our tour bus driver suggested the spot and said he loves that place and had no incentive to promote them. Just loved it haha

negative.text: Should be an affordable place but over $300 for only 5 people!! WTH. I ordered the fish of the day ( $35?!!) and the waiter asked "which topping" do you want? So I assumed it was included. Nope! additional $7.50!! And $3 for half a cup of rice?!? NOT WORTH IT!!
Ridiculous!! They have locks on their plugs for you not to charge your phone!!! When we asked why, they literally told us, owner doesn't care about being friendly to customers!! WTF

positive.text: Hands down the best cheesesteak in Philadelphia. Worth the drive and the wait. We find take out to be better than dine in - just seems like the longer they sit and melt together, the better. Delicious either way!
I know I know chicken at a cheese steak place but yes this is my fav chicken cheese steak with onion in the city, or in the Philly area rather! Highly recommend :)

The best cheesesteaks in Philly hands down!! I'd recommend going as soon as they open to avoid the line, but honestly the subs are worth the wait. They never disappoint. The subs are so big I can only eat half, and I usually eat the other half the next day. I 100% recommend!

negative.text: Why are you reading this and not going to get a steak... wtf if wrong with you. Stop reading a go now'

This place is disgusting, bread was soggy, the meat had no seasoning whatsoever. We looked in the window and we saw that the workers were not even wearing gloves while preparing our food. Dont go here, you will be only wasting your money.

positive.text: Great food. Pricey, but it's all good. The location is fantastic. It is easily one of the most beautiful restaurants I've ever been to. Perfect for a date or anniversary or Mother's Day.
Rat's is a great hidden gem, it can seem pricey but they have GREAT specials during happy hour! (5- 7) I recommend visiting then and checking out nearby grounds which are delightful!

Amazing restaurant. I loved the view and walkthrough of the garden. Everything here was amazing. A brunch turned into breakfast, lunch, dinner and dessert. Amazing experience. Loved every minute of it.

negative.text: Don't waste your time here. The food is not good and the service is equally horrible. Was disappointed to say the least
Quite tasty food, quite bad service: didn't bring things we ordered, checked in 3 times over the course of an hour. Also a beautiful spot to eat.

positive.text: This was the best spot to find here!!! Super good food and great drinks! Our server was the best! So energetic and informative.it was a great place to go after traveling all day and just wanting some food by the water! Would go again!!

Food was great. Nachos for appetizer were fresh with a good portion. Kids meals were good portions and the kids enjoyed the popcorn shrimp, sloppy joe sandwich, and macaroni and cheese. Personally I thought the fish and chips with fries was awesome. Great taste and very fresh. We should highly recommend

Enjoyed a delicious MaiTai while eating fresh shrimp. Could have done with a little less Old Bay Seasoning but very good nonetheless. Followed by amazing Gluten Free chicken wings. Absolutely nothing left on my plate. Even had another MaiTai! Service was excellent and provided by Kamilia.

negative.text: Not a fan. I loved the view, but the tables were sticky, the silverware dirty, the peel and eat shrimp was not deveined and overcooked, and wayyy too expensive. I hate writing bad reviews, but none of our party liked the food or "stickiness"

Nice views, pretty good food but problem with service. We were ignored several times when we requested something. The server did not return our credit card and we had a 40 minute drive to retrieve it. Management did not care. This could have been solved with an apology and piece of key lime pie to go!

positive.text: Long Live Fido! Love their coffee and the food is great too. I go there all the time when in town and I'm super stoked they have oat milk now! There are tons of places to sit, the place is huge! The staff is usually pretty friendly and it's overall a great hang every time.

Love this place! Staff are super nice, food is always prompt, and yummy! If you like breakfast all day and a comfy atmosphere where you can do work, catch up with a friend, or conduct business - this is your place!

I came in 5 minutes after they closed to pick up a bag of coffee. I cruised right by the counter like I owned the place and started inspecting roasted dates. A Fido employee approached me and very kindly said they were closed but offered to quickly ring up my bag with a smile. I love you guys! Keep up the great job!

negative.text: Aptly named for a dog! This place ain't what it used to be by a long shot. Absolute SHIT food and shit service. Ordered a simple eggs potatoes bacon and toast. The potatoes were barely cooked. The bacon was raw and smelled nasty. I just walked out. Wouldn't even give it one star if that was an option

Don't order to go from here took 30 minutes for a freaking bagel while I watched people behind me literally get there food before me. $16 for a bagel and cold brew was a waste of money. Finally after complaining to the poor barista, my order came out and then they ended up getting my order wrong

positive.text: Love Lolis! It's my spot for Taco Tuesdays! I usually get the carnita taco and the fish taco it's really fresh with the avocado on the top. Their sauces are also fresh as well. This place is great good for your pocket and great quality of food love it! Great spot for tacos in Tampa!
The tamales were delicious as well as the ribeye tacos!! Great customer service, kind employees. The strawberry drink is fresh and taste amazing! Definitely recommend
My favorite taco spot in Tampa! Great amazing tasting tacos. Love how authentic they are. Horchata is perfect and those onions they include on the side with every taco, so good!

negative.text: Just got tacos and was highly disappointed . This place use to have killer tacos . Def won't be back . Wish the taco stand right by the light was open
Good food but quality is just not the same anymore. DON'T order takeout. They always forget something or make it wrong.

positive.text: We had a great meal and perfect drinks. This is a really good choice if you like sushi and tapas. I happen to be a huge fan of wahoo and they had a wahoo ceviche that was pretty much perfection. Wait staff was prompt, knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. We will definitely return.

Couldn't have asked for a better experience. The ambiance, food and service were amazing. The bar and tables are perfectly clean. Tim was the best bartender and highly recommended. Thank you Tim for the best 3 old fashions of the night!!!

Wonderful atmosphere and spectacular food! My new favorite Thursday night dinner spot with 1/2 off fast plates (apps) and great drink specials. Our bartender Drew was awesome. He was friendly & helpful! Pretty cute too

negative.text: Fish is not fresh at all. Took almost an hour to prepare my order. Order was wrong; I asked for no wontons or red onion. It came out with both. Avocado is brown and contain pieces of the pit. Item doesn't match menu description at all. Overpriced, especially considering the poor quality of food.
The service here was terrible and you would get better sushi at a grocery store. Absolutely disgusting and a total waste of money

positive.text: What an amazing restaurant! Love the food! The decor is gorgeous and the servers are sweet! A must try for everyone! You have to try their northern French press coffee! Some lady in line just said she buys herself the $50 gift cards so she can get a $10 gift card for free! Smart thinking!
Scott is the best waiter!! So patient, positive, funny and gives the best service!! Also fantastic food, recommend the garden fritta and grand huevos rancheros
This is one of my favorite breakfast places around. Food is delicious and service is great I love the decor and atmosphere as well. You cannot go wrong with the lemon blueberry pancakes.. so yummy!

negative.text: this place has gone downhill it's such a shame!! I used to love coming... I got a chicken pesto panini today and the chicken was rubbery and chewy and the chips were sooo stale I couldn't even chew them... so disappointed... you'd think they would know when their food had gone bad before they served it

Great looking menu but failed to deliver. 1/2 the orders were messed up and the eggs were so salty you couldn't eat them. The crispy bacon was anything but. The orange juice is "fresh" squeezed some other place and delivered to the store according to our waitress. Wouldn't come back

positive.text: I loved it !!! Everything was amazing and delicious. I went with my husband to celebrate our anniversary and was a really beautiful surprise. Perfect place , romantic but also friendly, stunning food , nice staff and other fact is that the streets around are so cheerfully that all the environment made a perfect match.

This place was delicious. The menu is a QR code and is on your phone. Very clean. The food options are amazing and more filling than I expected. We shared four tapas plates and the white sangria and Sauvignon blanc were amazing. Filling and well appointed. Covid safe. Thank you. They have a great staff.
Scallops might have been the best I ever had! Steak was great along with the shrimp. Was a little bit of a wait! But nice atmosphere perfect for date night! Drinks were amazing! Staff was friendly

negative.text: I ordered food from here through Grubhub, and after 45 minutes, I was notified my order was cancelled. This was such a disappointment. There was no explanation or consolation. My main issue is why it took 45 minutes for them to cancel my order.
Some things are ok, but far less consistent that the distant past. TIRED.

positive.text: Ok I was a little concerned after reading some of the reviews, but OMG! Drinks were good, my wife said the lasagna was the best she's ever had. I had the shrimp po-boy with potato casserole. The casserole (hash brown) was probably the best I've ever had. Oh and great service to boot.
The best place we ate in St. Louis! Great atmosphere, fair prices and wonderful food. The gooey butter cake is The Bomb! Our server, Shay, was so friendly and right on top of things.
Enjoyable atmosphere, friendly staff, great food!!! Their house dressing and homemade rolls are superb!! The stuffed mushrooms are delicious choice, chicken Riesling always my favorite.

negative.text: This is one of the worst restaurants I've ever been to. It had terrible service, overpriced, disgusting foods, and nothing redeeming about it at all. I would never recommend this restuarant to anyone in the Saint Louis area, might as well eat the dirt off the ground before you go here.
The worst food, food was room temp. They said they warmed it up in the skillet but was still the same temp. Bad customer service would never recommend this food to anyone....

positive.text: Like an awesome old school diner. Great prices and Italian food was perfect for the price. Very generous portions, and the chocolate cake is amazing! Great service by wait staff also. Nice little hole in the wall!

Their pizza was good but nothing to rave about. I think their baklava cheesecake and the cannoli were on point and super delicious. Service was friendly and location was in a good spot. Wings were ok but pass on the bruschetta.

I can't explain how amazing our experience was. Sarah our server took amazing care of us, had us laughing and suggested great menu items! Thank you Sarah! The food was absolutely awesome! We will definitely be back!

negative.text: This was not very good Italian food. Bland and no taste. The bean soup was not good and the chicken parm and sauce did not have flavor. I don't understand the good reviews of this place as this is not Italian food... The only saving grace was that it was ridiculously low in price so that is why my expectations were low

I typically don't leave feedback, but was very disappointed with the service here. Placed an order for delivery, delivery was quick, but all down hill after that. They left out an order of chicken fingers & I ordered medium wings & received fried wings, no sauce

positive.text: Awesome place for seafood! So good and service is great for how busy they can get at the end of Stearns Wharf. Fabulous view as well! Love this place and we keep coming back as locals for multiple decades. Happy New Year!

Most amazing food! Lobster roll perfectly cooked. Super tender Clam pasta 5 stars Lobster pasta 4.5 stars Calamari sandwich 4 stars Lobster tacos 4 stars. Shell could be better texture Cioppino 4.5 stars. Fresh oysters - super fresh 5 stars Service was good Only bad part is I can't get this in the Bay area
Wonderful food, outstanding location at the end of Stearns Wharf, and the very best servers! A perfect way to enjoy sailboats and pelicans.

negative.text: I don't give out 1 star reviews often, and this is only for one item for takeout, but the Uni was insanely expensive and not good at all. All I could taste was seawater. They didn't clean it at all. They just literally threw it in a box, it was so lazily done.
Good quality food, service is not that great. The place was freezing cold, everyone was very uncomfortable, and they didn't turn on the heaters until when we were about to leave.

positive.text: In Tampa for work n pleasure we ate here because we wanted a taste experience. The ambience was visually exciting, with excellent service and the food was good. The cheesecake flan n coffee was GREAT. We came late n was happy to have a good Satisfying meal. Definitely will return.

This place is great! I was a skeptical because I don't know much about Cajun food but we tried it and it was great! All of the food looked so good it was hard to choose. What I ended up ordering was delicious and everyone else at the table loved their's as well!

First time there tonight... It's the closest you're going to get to Cajun food in Florida. Loved it!! The waitress was super awesome and the food delish! The hostesses were on it! Service was superb Food delish! Environment relaxing and festive!! Will return many times

negative.text: This is my 3rd dissatisfaction with this establishment, my food was horrible. I had the smallest shrimp ever and my son's fries were cold. I WILL NEVER EAT AT TIBBY'S AGAIN
Not great imitation of New Orleans cuisine. Just doesn't measure up to real Cajun or Creole restaurants of New Orleans Good Bloody Marys though

positive.text: I'm not the biggest ramen eater ever but this was some of the best I've had before. My friend goes all the time and recommended that I get the miso ramen and it didn't disappoint at all ( I got it spicy). The service was great and if you are a hip hop listener you'll like the music they play.

Wow! This ramen was some of the best I've had and I've had ramen all over. Loved the TanTan ramen although it's definitely more spicy than they say. I wouldn't say it's "mild" Loved everything we got and so happy we found this place! Definitely a must go.

Best ramen I've eaten in Philadelphia! Umami to the 1000th degree! When I want ramen, this is exactly what I think of. Service is fast, the food is amazing (the dumplings are really great too but I didn't get a picture). Help keep them open through Covid please! The eggs are perfectly flavored and nicely soft. Go here!

negative.text: Staff are rude. Ramen is just very normal. While we were still eating our ramen, staff came and took away our bowl. That's very rude and disrespectful.

Such a long wait... great ramen, but we were on the waitlist at around 5:30pm and ended up getting seated between 8-9pm. If you are dead set on coming here for dinner, do takeout for the fastest route or get on the Yelp waitlist VERY early (which is the only option for making reservations).

positive.text: Great food, friendly staff, good prices and overall amazing experience. No complaints whatsoever. I ordered the mullet and it was smoked to perfection. My friends ordered the salmon and mahi mahi and which were also amazing. Definitely will return when I am in the area again!

I was a little bit afraid because I never tried SMOKED fish... but I must confess that worth the 1hr trip. Good amount of food. The staff was very friendly! We love our experience and definitely we will come back!
Doesn't look much when you pass by but the fish is AMAZING and very fresh! Recommend this place to anyone who love smoked fish...

negative.text: Sign says they are open until 7:30. We arrived at 6:45 and a VERY rude wan informed us that they were closing and only doing cold to go. Why advertise that you're open until 7:30 and then be rude to people who who up to pay?

I use to go out of the way for some Ted Peter fish spread sandwiches. The last few times it sucked! You can taste a little bit of the smoke fish but it's mostly mayonnaise now. You use to actually see the fish and spices but not anymore. And domestic beer is almost $5.00 a 12 oz. can. Sad to say but I'll never be back.

name: Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Tampa

positive.text: This is a amazing place I go every year sometimes twice. This year I actually won, but I love the staff the atmosphere the food the music playing over head an most importantly the other guest who have always been fun and helpful

Huge complex but well organized. Very clean. Plenty of parking that is free. Event center is intimate with comfy seats. Plenty of bathrooms that are clean. It's a casino so you need to walk through it to get anywhere. The casino is bright but has an overwhelming smell of smoke. Will return.
Vegas style casino hotel in Florida. I've had great luck and the staff is awesome! Plenty of games for everyone to enjoy. The table games are wonderful. The decor is legendary!

negative.text: I came here today (7/13/2021) and had my bag stolen. I went to one of the workers and told them what happened and was told there was nothing they could do. They have cameras everywhere but there is nothing they could do? I WOULD NOT recommend coming here. Filthy, dirty place!

This was by far the worst experience I had in my life at a casino! Don't waste your time! Dealer was horrible. I hit blackjack she took my cards and money then they had to run the cameras back to pay me!

name: Harvest Seasonal Grill & Wine Bar - Glen Mills

positive.text: Love this place ... Beautiful ambiance ... Delicious .. super delicious food , very good friendly staff. This was my first visit to this place n I can't wait to visit again . We had lobster avacado toast .... It was superb ... Fish was very delicious and dessert was perfect end to delicious dinner

We had an amazing dinner tonight at Harvest. Our server,Emma, was a huge part of the experience. Food was really good but appreciated the attention we reviewed from Emma. Always there to ensure we had enough water, wine and we're enjoying our food. Harvest is good Emma made the experience
Delicious. Felt like I eating all healthy ingredients. The swordfish was delicious. Good wine. Good service. Great food.

negative.text: I have been a long time customer of this place. Food is decent but it often needs a condiment. Found out they no longer offer mustard!!!! I eat their burgers often - they need mustard. How can a restaurant decide to not offer condiments??? Now that I ate the dry burger, I may never order another
The charred Chicken Sesame was awful. The salad did not contain all of the ingredients listed on the menu. Over rated over priced

positive.text: Absolutely delicious. Order a latte with cinnamon, the coffee here is amazing. For brunch I ordered the steak and eggs and it was SO good. Highly recommend this place. Service was also awesome, super sweet staff & great vibes.

Great food, great service, great waitress (Taylor with the fabulous eyebrows was a sweetheart) and we loved we could get on the waitlist from our AirBnb to give us an estimate of arrival time. I ordered the Croque Madam with a side of grits and highly recommend.

I visit Nashville about 6 times a year and Marché has become a staple of every visit. The food is creative and delicious - my favorite is the croissant French toast. It's got a great neighborhood vibe and the hosts and servers are super friendly. The help waitlist simplified the queuing process. I highly recommend!

negative.text: The service here is beyond awful. We were told the wait for a table was one hour, and two hours later were still standing there. Would not recommend unless you plan on the wait time being double of what was told. Terrible service and hostesses.

The No Wait app they tell you to use to get in line is useless, we are still waiting to be sat despite using the app. The hostesses continue to delay seating our party and extending our wait time. No breakfast meal is worth this.

positive.text: Perfect brunch! Drive here from St. Pete and decided to have brunch and wait for the dog to lift (it never did!) But brunch here was amazing! The coffee was delicious. I ordered the Hey Lucy Omelette and it was so good! Would definitely recommend! Staff was friendly and the service was great!
Great service, the staff is super friendly. Excellent food, I had the best waffle. Awesome place for brunch, best mimosa

Awesome food!! Upscale and also have gluten free food. Apple fritter French toast Gluten free with banana and pecans with buttery sauce. Called Fosters. The best in Clearwater Beach Cathy was awesome ask for her. Beignets we're awesome free too!

negative.text: Bacon was hideous! Ruined everything else. All other food was good and service is decent.

Worst poached egg I've ever had, it was served in a puddle of water and the white was rubbery. not sure how they managed that, a side order of bacon consisted of ONE strip of bacon. Had heard great things about their unique menu, but it was so not.

positive.text: Awesome location. The interest of the building itself is a true art piece. The staff is very friendly. The food was excellent, and might I add the best ranch EVER!!! Good beer and drinks! Fun atmosphere, great place to grab drinks and pub grub

Great place. Great ambiance and awesome cocktails, the service is great and the folks that work there are kind and attentive. This place has a warm, welcoming environment and the food is delicious. We got the salmon, the depot burger and wings as appetizers, and we can't wait to go back since the food is so good!
Love this place, beautiful building, amazing beer, service is always tip top! Love this place for a great night out after a few pecans next door at Louis. Love this place!

negative.text: I was excited to try this place after hearing good reviews . The building is incredible! Unfortunately, the food was mediocre and the service was a disaster!! Really rude waitresses and staff ! We will not be returning. Too many other spots to go in this town.

The mixed drink are really good but the spirits hare very hot. I have never been impressed by this establishment and after the third visit with black limp fries I'm not sure I'll be back. We did get 6 buck taken off the tab but being underwhelmed time and time again I just can't get behind this place

positive.text: What a great gift this BBQ is to Sparks, NV!!!! Service is amazing! Even other customers are friendly and the food...oh the food!!! Best BBQ I've ever had & I have spent some time in Kansas City!!! Cara was a great server, although we've never had a bad one!

Came here and I loved it. Food, service and atmosphere is excellent. Will come back again when we're intown. Most definitely recommend this place to all rib lovers, meat lovers and pork lovers. They also have fried asses. Must try that too. Family friendly kind of place.

This is one of the better barbecue places in Sparks if you're there stop by there's a lot of great food and the service is fantastic, the owner Jay is great, Kristyn is awesome and is a great waitress. We will definitely go back

negative.text: My husband ate here and he said it's nasty seems like they boil there chicken and ribs brisket was coo beans taste like they put tomatoe paste mac&cheese nasty no flavor my husband said they need to close down its so nasty
After being on hold for 20 minutes was told they do not accept to go orders until after 7 pm (this was 5:30). Very disappointed. Called another restaurant.

positive.text: Boy oh boy this place is busy, but it's worth the wait. It's right in the middle of a great shopping and walking experience. The food here is great and the staff are nice and friendly as well as know how to show you a good time. They have a bakery connected so be sure to grab something on the way out.

I got the Greek style scallops and it was so good. Probably my fav Greek dish I've had. The scallops were so dressy and the sauce was so yummy, like nothing else I've had. The service was terrific. Must get the saganaki (flaming cheese) and the kids Greek style spaghetti was great too. Love this place.

Had a wonderful birthday dinner this afternoon. Our server was perfect - made great recommendations for cocktails and food. The birthday song and baklava were so appreciated. Great food and the service top notch. Highly recommend!

negative.text: The experience there was horrible and we never want to go again. They serve Greek salad with just 2 tomato and 2 cucumber slices and lettuce (!!!). Worst of all, my partner and I have diarrhea and still suffering from stomach pain. Avoid this restaurant !

An incredible gastronomic experience, The service and attention is incredible, and the food to die for. I will go back to Hellas again to check out other dishes. And I almost forgot to mention that their bakery is incredible also. You must go and try their baklava cheese cake.

positive.text: This place has a casual, fun atmosphere. The food is great, and ordering drinks/food is super efficient. I had the James Brown poboy and it was definitely one of the best poboys I've ever had. Their Bloody Mary was delicious as well. I highly recommend this place! Go on an empty stomach!

Visited this spot today for the first time and ordered the shrimp po'boy with all the fixin's. Po'boy was loaded with delicious seasoned shrimp! The bread was perfect! Delicious!!! Great food. Great customer service. Definitely a must try!
Wow! Delicious! The shrimp po'boys were overflowing with shrimp. The jambalaya was delicious. Definitely worth the trip and the line. Service was fantastic, as well. We highly recommend.

negative.text: Very good fried shrimp po boy. The bread pudding was heavy on the rum glaze, which really took away from the dish. I wouldn't recommend it or get it if I came back for the po boy. However, they aren't known for their bread pudding, they are known for their po boys, and that did not disappoint!
Get a ton of food for the money.. po boys are good but shrimp not very seasoned ... and jambalaya could use more sausage .. try the surf and turf po boy .. roast beef is very good!

positive.text: Been coming here for years (from Chicago) and seems to get better every year. Always great services, pleasant, happy staff. Delicious food and drink choices. Shout out to our super nice server Truman, he was wonderful!!!! Best of luck to you during these difficult times, see you next years
