Best place for a dinner. Food was amazing and ambience was good as well . Ordered Firecracker Shrimp, Wings , Coconut Shrimp entree . Everything tasted great , absolutely loved it .

negative.text: Absolutely DISGUSTING. I have been here a few times, and today's experience has absolutely marked my last time ever visiting this restaurant. I was given moldy beef empanadas. Please see the photo. I am so sick to my stomach. DO NOT EAT HERE.
Not as great as I thought it would be. Our waitress was extremely unprofessional and did not know anything about the menu. The food was ok but nothing to write home about.

positive.text: First time here. The perfect definition of dive bar. But a five star dive bar. The wings live up to the hype. So big and meaty and the amount of flavors for them is great. Nachos were great as well. Good service, good beers, good food.....great night.
Best wings, great service, wonderful crowd. My favorite bar. Would suggest this place to all locals and newcomers alike. The menu is great and the staff is even better. I love this place.

The Jug Handle Inn was a very nice place. Food was great and service was fantastic. My wife and I ordered food drinks and burgers and had a great time. I would definitely recommend coming here. Thank you for having us and we will definitely be back for seconds.

negative.text: Wanted to sit inside but it was closed even though they are allowed to be open. Forced to sit outside on a cold night. Food took an hour to come out and it was burned. Packaged in to go containers even though we were eating in, really??? Will never return to this disgusting shit hole
Worst customer service ever! From the bartender down to the "owner". No respect to a couple who has been coming there for awhile. Noted all whites working there, no diversity.

positive.text: Best vegetarian chili I have ever had. I was with 4 people and everyone enjoyed their meal. The pork belly was delicious. The pretzels are wonderful and I had a cocktail called " grey line" that was amazing. This restaurant is a fun place to gather in groups or just a friend and have great food and drinks.

We came for the Smash burgers and they did not disappoint. I don't normally eat bread but the pretzel bun was so good. Definitely a great burger but we did come on Tuesday when they gave all you can eat tacos and good priced patron margaritas. Serve was okay but they were super busy was hockey night.

Had such a great time here last night!! Came here with a few of my friends and was served right away at the bar, such great service from bartenders Maddie and Chris, super friendly and attentive!! will 100% be coming back!! Had the Grey Line drink which was super yummy !

negative.text: Tried to give this place another chance.... Horrible service.... Bad food... caught 2 bogus charges on our tab.... Never going here again!

First Yelp review. Sat at the bar, and the service was god awful. Food was cold after having to wait 20 mins to order. Had to flail my arms around to get the waitresses attention after one flat out ignored me. Will not be coming back.

positive.text: Great restaurant with GREAT food and a super nice staff! Definitely get there early though, or you'll probably have a long wait. We got there at 6:45 on a Saturday morning and didn't have to wait at all, to help give you an idea. It's totally worth getting up early for though!

The best pankcakes I've ever had hands down. Seriously the best pancakes I've ever had in my life. Light and fluffy. The maple syrup was also the best I've ever had. The hash browns were crispy- which I loved. Great service and a bustling restaurant, the pancake pantry is a hit!

Loved the Pancake Pantry! The Swedish pancakes were great and I loved how they were served. So many lingonberries both on top and inside. We were so glad to have finally been able to go after a few days of super long lines! Weekdays are the way to go or lunch time to avoid long lines.

negative.text: Go early to avoid lines at this Nashville staple restaurant. Pancakes abound with both traditional and unique flavors (Santa Fe Cornmeal Cakes). No frills and no drinks but with the stop for the tradition.
No vegan pancakes. The Avocado toast comes with two eggs and a hefty price tag. No oat milk or non- dairy creamer options.

positive.text: Yats is obviously amazing. But this location is my favorite and also amazing. The people working here are great honestly. And for the price Yats is just simply the best and always a go to. Definitely wish I could have this right now! The chili cheese and drunken chicken are the best in my opinion.

Great food. Great people. Great price. Yats is one of my friend's and my favorite places to go. We get huge portions of delicious food. It's something unique and different. The atmosphere is fun and the cashiers are always super friendly. Go check this place out!
family friend of the business and everyone is always there with a smile and is super nice to my friends and family and i truly appreciate it. how could i not recommend such a great community

negative.text: If you live in Indy, I doubt you're using Yelp to weigh going to Yats because you already know what to expect which is affordable tasty food served up on a disposable (though never biodegradable) plate. Beads Tasty bread - get the double order

The food is really yummy, if you can't eat spicy (like me) ((I think bbq is spicy)) you probably won't succeed here. BUT if you can get past your Bitch taste buds. It is tasty!!! I just can't. The bread is really good though, if you want to make a meal out of that

positive.text: Had a great experience today at Sushi Rose. Big thanks to them for offering a free birthday meal. The birthday girl was ecstatic. Everything was delicious. I loved my veggie tempura long roll. Green tea and miso soup was great! Super clean and fast service. Thank you!

Great sushi amazing prices. Went here with a few friends to get all you can eat and we were taken care of very well. On Mondays if you order all you can eat, alcohol is free. The sushi tasted very good and they were very filling. The service was fast and great, so I will be recommending this place to others.

This place is absolutely legit. Normally if you go to sushi bar you want smaller pieces but here it's nice to get smaller ones so you can enjoy more. EVERYTHING here is so good!! Added bonus: come here on your bday for free AY

negative.text: Pretty underwhelming. i got all you can eat sushi and it took quite a long time for rolls to be delivered. not a huge deal, but annoying. the sushi itself was okay but not great. i'd probably come here again for lunch (cheaper for all you can eat), but not for dinner. not great, not awful, just kinda meh :/

Can't complain food is not the best, but is okay. Overall service kinda ruined my experience waitress with glasses not very friendly if she can't deal with people maybe she should look for another job! :/

positive.text: This was the best breakfast we had on a visit to Tucson. So fresh! Interesting menu options, delicious latte, amazing fresh tangerine juice. It felt like a chef works here- not just line cooks. I wish we'd gone more than once! The service was friendly, attentive and thanked you for coming.

One of our favorites in Tucson! They have a new chicken salad sandwich that is fresh and so so delicious! They've also done an amazing job during the pandemic to keep everyone safe and are awesome for offering takeout and groceries. I also love their cobb salad and the giant pancake. Yum!!

We came here because it was recommended to us by someone on Reddit and OMG! Such wonderful, fresh and delicious food. We had the smoked salmon English muffin with poached eggs and the sausage sandwich. Highly recommend. And they are super kind and friendly. Thank you!

negative.text: Good food but poor service. The last few times I have went there and sat outside I've been ignored and waited over 30 mins to get my coffee brought out and been harassed by homeless people nearby while the waiters have never donE anything to help.
$11.00 for a teeny, tiny sandwich and no meaningful sides? Really? And noise levels unabated by its harsh furnishings? This place needs to take its gentrification and shove it.

positive.text: Great coffee, fun choices such as Almond Joy and Teddy Graham and a wonderful latte. Great food - freshly made on site by a real cook. Delicious veggie egg sandwich. Super nice friendly people working there. Loved this!

Perfect brunch. Amazing freshly squeezed orange juice. One of the best I had in a long time. Great mimosa. And the frittata was not only beautiful but very delicious. Very cute and cozy place with great service, very easy access and parking. Outside seating available. Loved it!!!

What a cute spot! I was in town visiting and wanted to find a good coffee shop... not only was the coffee delicious but the food was outstanding. Staff was super friendly and efficient. Nice and clean establishment with cool local art on display. A must try!

negative.text: They have amazing coffee drinks but we haven't been impressed with the food. It is fairly expensive compared to other restaurants in the area and not nearly as good. We will stick with the coffee drinks!
Really hate leaving a bad review, but only 1 out of the 5 employees I saw had a mask one. One actually removed her mask to make my coffee.

positive.text: this place is amazing! it's my husband and my first time in new orleans and we HAD to try gumbo but i don't like seafood...this place had amazing veggie gumbo! seriously so good. their fresh bread was the best i've ever had and service was amazing!

this was a good place to try I was excited to try the gumbo of course but both of the gumbos was just ok BUT what ever special they had for the sample plate was AMAZING I think it was artichoke something soup OMG the best ever

Not the sleepy place it used to be. Line out the door but it moved fast since we are two. Sat in the courtyard and it was cool. Ordered the corn chowder soup and the blackened catfish with crab cake and a delicious gravy. Both were great. Place was packed the entire time we were there. Definitely recommend.

negative.text: 1 star as the food really isn't good enough. The service is great and the restaurant itself looks nice. But the food and drinks were of poor quality unfortunately
Totally disappointing!!! Jambalaya missing ingredients, etouffee okay, shrimp creole okay. The seafood gumbo was laughable, I'm still looking for the seafood.

positive.text: Wow. This food is amazing. Season 52 has a great atmosphere and the employees have a great attitude. The food is awesome. The scallops are perfectly cooked. The chicken was marinated perfectly. So tender. The lamb pops were on point and the shrimp was grilled perfectly. I highly recommend seasons 52

This place was amazing. Amazing service Waitress was one of the greatest of all time I have never had service like this before Lisa was amazing really appreciate the kindness of her guiding us through the menu Thanks again had a wonderful time will be back for sure

Fantastic!!!!! We chose this Restaurant to celebrate a special family occasion. We were not disappointed. The service and atmosphere is awesome. For a precious moment in our lives we felt like royalty having dinner here. If your looking for fine dining, I highly recommend Seasons 52.

negative.text: Under staffed, horrible service, they can't even answer their phones. This place is a complete dumpster fire and I'm annoyed that they stole so much of my time.
Omg this place is terrible. The food has no flavor to it. Our server was inexperienced and the manager was not responsive. Never Again.

positive.text: Love this place. Great seating, atmosphere, indoor and outdoor. Great british/indian food. They even have good british beers on tap. Great burgers, great tandoori food, lots of fun and great prices. One of the best places to eat in Downtown St. Pete.

Great spot for happy hour! Great location and atmosphere. We chose several appetizers from the happy hour menu so enjoyed a fun eclectic mix of international flavors - Thai curry soup, Chana masala, pierogies, fried cod and Cuban sandwich. Wonderful flavors in all! Excellent service too!

We came here twice during our trip and really enjoyed the happy hour. The vibe is really nice and I love all the old wood...the place also smells like delicious curry pretty much nonstop. Service was friendly and the prices are a lot better than many of the nearby competitors.

negative.text: Terrible service for vegans. Waiter was inattentive he could serve a process veggie burger patty with raw onion and pickle. Just because they double deep on butter. Disgusting hummus appetizer tasted like unwelcoming flavorless appetizers. Terrible costumer service no regrets.
Horrible service! Spent 40 min waiting for lunch. Came with very hungry kids and place was not even busy. Never coming back

positive.text: The Midway was perfect! Totally redone, new games and prizes all the time, well worth the money. I have fun whether it's with my grandchildren or adults. Its a fun and worth it. The best game is the camel races. We get to interact with a real person and be competitive

Was skeptical about booking this hotel. But it's very clean and the rooms are spacious. The Vegas Circus Circus is horrible but Reno is very nice. I highly recommend and will be returning. The staff is great. Very friendly.
Stayed here from the 5th through the 9th and the staff was great. Room was nice and clean. The maid service everyday was amazing. Wish they had a pool or access to the pool at the adjoining hotels.

negative.text: Stay ANYWHERE else! This hotel is disgusting. The carpets are dirty the rooms are dusty they tried to "renovate" and they failed, i felt so disgusted staying there. My room had mold in the shower don't ever stay here it's not worth it!

Casino ? Smh what a disappointment you guys really need a major upgrade all the slots were old and very limited , we walked and walked to just walk out. No new slots I don't even think I saw table games. No wonder the casino was empty.

positive.text: The energy in this restaurant is positive and friendly. Their smiles are beautiful and the food is so delicious! This is a restaurant and experience I am truly grateful for. I feel like they remember me each time I go in. I wish I had taken a photo of my dish! Thanks you guys!!
The Food was AMAZING!!! The cashier was so sweet and awesome! Thank you guys again! I will definitely be back for more awesome food!! Was worth EVERY PENNY!
Best Food and best service!!! Best Loco moco and breakfast selections . Pancakes are awesome and the Island menu are delicious. Will definitely come back agian once we visit Reno. Mahalo!!

negative.text: Ridiculous, played by the rules and my son and I are FULLY VACCINATED and these Jack-asses have a sign that says "DESPITE the CDC, we still require masks". So, you believe the CDC when they say to use masks, but are so retarded that you don't believe when we DONT HAVE TO WEAR THEM. Probably think the earth is flat too.

We were looking forward to trying the food this morning, however they had a sign on the door saying that they were "Still requiring masks to be worn by customers despite the new CDC Guidelines." So we, along with several other couples, chose to go elsewhere

positive.text: This is one of the better cheesesteak places in Philadephia. I really love the fresh sautéed onions and the beef is always super fresh. Great place to get a good cheesesteak. Stay away from Genos and Pats.
1st timer & I liked it.The meat was good just wish they added some salt when cook it. Great service, the serves are amazing. Definitely a very popular place, the line was around the corner.
BEST cheesesteaks ever. If you have taste, you'd agree. Imo Jim's wins the "original cheesesteak" fight. Long lines suck, but the food is SO worth the wait. Service is friendly, atmosphere is great.

negative.text: Taller white guy that works there is the definition of a pos. stay away from this dump. I don't care if they serve gold. This guys attitude was horrifying. Feel bad for anyone that has to work with this disgusting human.

Dry as hell. Bland. No seasoning on the meat. No juice. No melted cheese. Just terrible. From a south Philly Italian this place is a joke and should stop coasting on their old rep and actually give a shit and make a good sandwich. Trash.

name: The Cake Bake Shop by Gwendolyn Rogers-Broad Ripple Village

positive.text: Loooooveeeee!! This place has wonderful cakes (and desserts in general), GREAT service, and an AMAZING atmosphere!! I love coming here...with friends, for date nights, bringing little ones, and more! It even has a room perfect for little get togethers with small groups. Definitely recommend...year round!

Do it for the gram- the atmosphere is gorgeous. A true basic B's dream. But pretty much stops there. These overpriced baked options are good but not the $15 dollar per slice good. There are better baked options right down the street at Renee's. Friendlier staff and better prices too.

Gwendolyn Rodgers has the best cakes/desserts!!! I just had to buy my favorite slice of Mint Chocolate Cake along with the Cake Bake Charm bracelet & Charms!!! I Love them all! Excellent Service and Desserts. My happy place when visiting "Indy!"

negative.text: The staff was very rude and made fun of my body and what I ordered. They didnt even try to hide their rude comments which just shows how entitled they think they are. Very disappointed and will never go there or recommend to anyone else.
Not a single person was wearing a mask, including staff and desert was extremely overpriced. It was $45 dollars for basic deserts. Would not return

positive.text: What a fabulous gem of a place! The most amazing scones you'll ever see and you need at least two people to eat one LOL. I had the buckaroo breakfast which was steamed eggs bacon turkey cheese. Super delicious! The coffee is fabulous as well! Really cute place to hang out great atmosphere! Must see when in Boise!

This is the most amazing breakfast spot! The food is amazing and portions are huge! The selection is awesome and good prices. The atmosphere is rad and the decor is on point! The owner is always on the hustle and makes sure everyone is taken care of with full happy bellies! I love this place !!!!

No one does serving sizes like Big City! Emphasis on Big! I love that you always get your money's worth and delicious!!! I love the big cinnamon roll and the frittatas are so good! Yum I can't wait to go back. The coffee is so delicious too! Yes they have my favorite, white chocolate mocha!!

negative.text: Do not get the wrap it's disgusting and a mess, the potatoes are gross and the avocado was brown. Wasted my money!

Horrible quality with food especially the Biscuits and Gravy. no taste and bland, the biscuits are made too hard and not fluffy at all. also young girl was doing her hair right in the middle of the food service area wtf.

positive.text: Stopped in on a beautiful Sunday afternoon, place was slammed... but what a great location so the short wait was worth it. Tawny our server was amazing, as busy as they were she was still attentive,upbeat and so sweet. Food was outstanding and the drinks on point. Cool place good vibes great service !

As a visitor to Clearwater Beach, did a Yelp search and found this place. It was a great find!! Awesome seafood, great drinks and reasonably priced. Loved it so much, went back the next night. Alex was our waiter both nights and he is the best. Friendly and great service. Will be back again next time we are in Florida!
Great food, creative menu, fun atmosphere, I loved the grouper nuggets, Mexican sweet corn, crab fries and of course the grouper egg rolls. Tiffane was awesome too, excellent service and good times.

negative.text: Food is decent, atmosphere is drunk assholes who cannot hold a conversation and start fights when their "girl" speaks with any other person. Terrible bar.

Frenchys South Beach Cafe is just horrible. I went with my wife and kids and we all hated this place. Not one good thing to say, except that the staff was nice. The seafood is just not good or fresh tasting. We have eaten seafood all over the Florida, and Frenchys South Beach was well below average. We will not return.

positive.text: Amazing food! Try the chicken nuggets, the burritos and the gluten free pancakes! Omg they are the best pancakes I ever had! Super yummy and super friendly staff
LOVE LOVE LOVE Amazing menu and service. Really neat artwork that you can purchase all hung up around; highly recommend.

Buffalo cauliflower wings are amazing! Still thinking about them! Also loved the Curry and cookies! Staff is super friendly and helpful! They delivered right to my car! Eager to go back and try breakfast once the world returns to normal. Great vegan eats!

negative.text: The faux meats here have fantastic texture. However most of the food is under seasoned and bland. Including the sauces!! So sad that they don't know how to season things. So annoying!

So dissatisfied again. 4 strikes I'm done. They seem too cool to be polite. Then you wait half an hour. Then your burrito is filled with mostly French fries. For some reason I thought a California Burrito would have fresh vegetables and avocado. 16 + dollars (for one) and rudely served bleh.

positive.text: Great atmosphere, huge beer selection (local and nation wide), clean, good service. Let's talk about this super yummy sandwich. Yes! Amazing- savory, sweet, crispy, a little bit of everything. I took half home bc well it was big and delicious. So excited to have the leftover too. Definitely recommend.
Great spot with delish vegan options! Great if you're on a group with different dietary needs. Fun pub like environment with wonderful energy and very friendly staff.
This place is amazing! Came here while on our weekend trip and got their delicious steaks. I highly recommend the 20oz steak , absolutely delicious and worth every penny. Definitely worth our wait!!!

negative.text: We made reservevations for our family of 7 a week before. We sat down and 30 mins later after we ordered they told us our two little kids have to sit by themselves at a different table. HOW RUDE AND DISREPECTFUL. Been going here for years. Today they lost our business

I'm a regular patron of Yardhouse. I've visited the establishment in several states as I am from California. I was refused service here after ordering about $50 in food and drinks. Don't recommend. Asked for management who did not solve my problems. Terrible experience. Recommend NADA or another downtown establishment.

positive.text: My guilty pleasure! Yes, it's a dive bar, but its darkness and simplicity is its allure! It's nothing fancy, but everything good! Seriously one if the best burgers and baked potatoes around for the best value! Oh- and indulge in a monsoon- a fruity cocktail with quite a punch! You'll be left full and happy!!!

This is one of our go-to restaurants when we visit New Orleans! The best burger I've had at a restaurant and the bake potato's are amazing! Also, the specialty drinks are delicious (if not a bit dangerous lol). Highly recommend eating here, if there's a wait, wait. You won't be disappointed!!

The drinks are strong AF and the burgers and so tasty! I normally don't like baked potatoes but theirs were absolutely amazing. I did not sit inside but I love the outdoor seating and quick service. I feel like the bill can add up really quickly with all the toppings but it's definitely worth it.

negative.text: Hamburgers are just ok... staff is rude!! Felt extremely sick after eating here. OVERRATED!!!

The burgers were SO UNDER COOKED neither me or my partner could take more than 2 bites. It was raw mush. The drink I got had too much alcohol and my partners had too much juice. We paid 60+ for 2 burgers and 2 drinks and I'm so disappointed. I love Port of Call but this was the worst food experience I've ever had here.

positive.text: Food was Amazing and the people that work there were so friendly and kind. The outside is set up so beautiful and it peaceful and beautiful. Definitely recommend this place for someone looking for a good place to eat a Burger and have a couple of drinks!

I had the best waiter! He recommended his favorite Nashville hot chicken... it's delicious!! Will definitely get again. The horseradish coleslaw was amazing too, the heat will melt your face off. The patio is great, was a perfect night for it. Thanks Brad!
Great atmosphere! The bar area high tops are our favorite place to sit with friends. The wedge salad is delicious and their burgers are amazing. Great beer selection too!

negative.text: Ordered a well done burger and got a rare one. Sadly it was ordered thru Doordash so I was stuck with it. :-( Food is generally very good, but very disappointed the burger was rare.
Just depends on who cooks your order. Wide variance in quality, might not be back. Didn't have to pay for the bad, if I sent it back, manager made sure it was done right! Coin toss.

positive.text: 10/10 would recommend! The owner was amazing! She noticed us as soon as well entered those doors, cared for us to have a great experience. We had El pecado dessert trio, it's a must if you're a sweets lover. Would be coming back for sure.

Always a delight to eat here, as I do every time I am in town! Mole is wonderful, service excellent, owner/chef makes you feel like family. Everything I want in a restaurant! I love the decor. The plates overflow with food! Bring a to go box and enjoy it again at home!

The menu changes daily and is written on chalkboards. Brought my entire family and they all loved it! The food is outstanding, unique, fresh, delicious, and made with heart. One of the best meals I've had.

negative.text: Overpriced Mexican food! $25.00 chicken Paper napkins Added gratuity on table of 6??

I certainly was not impressed. The tortilla was warmer than the food and the meat was tough. That's two strikes already. The third was the price. The food was simple and tried to glorify with lots of garnish. Flavor was basic to bland.

positive.text: Love this place. My first time here and it was an amazing experience overall. Food was great and everything came out super fast. Mike was our server, he was truly amazing. He made us feel so comfortable and had great recommendations as far as the menu and drinks. I will definitely be back. Thankyou Mike!

I love the lady bartender her name starts with an E she's great. The guy bartender is nice as well. The happy hour is nice 4-6:30 pm apps starting at $5 nice drinks are always great good place to go and enjoy yourself.

I've been here dozens of times but I have to say this was my best experience. Our server Amber was amazing. Very accommodating and informative about the menu. We definitely felt like we're in good hands. Food was good but Amber stole the show. Hopefully she's here the next time I come here to eat.

negative.text: The worst service, disorganized meal I have ever had at this location! Plus my entree was horrible. Choose a different restaurant!
Horrible customer service. Will never go back again. Wait time was awful. Was told 5 min wit that turned into 40 and the staff laughed when I asked them about it. Very unprofessional

positive.text: Wonderful Restaurant! I have eaten here many many times. Their tacos are pretty amazing! The menu is small but perfect. There are veggie options too. The interior is colorful and unique. I love the bright colors and design. Make sure you check out the bathroom fun! Lol

Some of the best food I have had! Tacos were outstanding! Queso (loaded) was incredible. Desert was incredible! Staff was outstanding. Hope to come again! Did an excellent job enforcing social distancing and masks! Felt super safe here. :)

This place was delicious! I love the fusion Mexican style. It's great served family style and you can try a whole bunch of different things with your friends. Tons of gluten free options! Service was awesome very friendly and helpful

negative.text: The trend of ambiance over quality is NADAs saving grace. The restaurant is decorated and looks very nice, but the food is not good. I try not to be overly negative , but this is one of the blandest places I've ever been.
My absolute go-to when I'm in the downtown area. I will never not hype up the chips & queso at this place, they're like no other! Plus their hongos tacos are to die for.

positive.text: A delicious romantic dessert and drink spot. I had a salted caramel martini and the cheese platter. I would highly recommend both. Completely yummy!! My husband had the white chocolate blonde. Also delicious. Our waitress, Chelsea was so sweet and helpful. Loved her!!

Love going to Bailey's! Always a great service and a chill atmosphere. The desserts are great but my favorite is probably the chocolate martini. There usually isn't too bad of a wait but can be pretty busy on the weekends. Great for a girls night.
The trip is worth tiramisu martini is awesome, our server was great. Perfect couples spot! Very nice place if you love a quit drink and wonderful desserts!

negative.text: 1 star for not updating their hours. This store is currently under renovation, but it still says they're open so I wasted 20 minutes driving out here. Will try it someday but today I'm disappointed
Craving a fancy dessert? Look no further! Perfect for a date night or ladies night out! I find myself craving the whole menu!

positive.text: LOVED this place. Dreamed of coming here since I was little. Of course it's going to be expensive but it truly was an experience I have never had before. Went for lunch and it was perfection. LOVED the staff. Food was awesome.

I grew up watching Emeril so it was a real treat to finally get to one of his restaurants! Amazing service and delicious food. Dessert was amazing as well! Recommend for lunch or dinner for a special occasion or just a really good meal!

Very well done! I was a party of one, but was treated with great service from the outstanding your waiters asst to the waiter himself...food s bit on the meager side in portion suze... but perfectly prepared

negative.text: Very disappointing on every level! The food was okay but not authentic creole as advertised. The service was beyond terrible!!! Our wait staff was switched out three times at least, they forgot to bring out food, did not have wine we wanted.... Staff was also arrogant and not knowledgeable. Would not go back...
It's an extraordinary restaurant which is no surprise. I'm not sure you can get a bad meal. The interior is upscale but doesn't seem like classic New Orleans. Service is attentive.

positive.text: Spot was super yummy! Highly recommend and will definitely be coming back on our next visit to Santa Barbara! Delicious food, super clean, outdoor seating, friendly service, and all around was provided with a great service.

Delicious, satisfying food for a great price, great hospitality, definitely very welcoming environment to enjoy breakfast and lunch! Ordered the Fried Chicken Benedict with a Modelo Negra Michelada and was not disappointed. Will definitely be back and recommend all my friends try this place
Excellent service! The seasoning on the potatoes is absolutely splendid. The turkey bacon was cooked to perfection. Overall, super happy and recommend. Everybody is so nice here.

negative.text: Everyone has to eat outside during Covid. This place had customers waiting taking up tables at adjacent eateries. How rude. It is a sign of bad management. I will check back and see if the fix that.
I ordered fried chicken egg benedict. I wasn't good at all. The chicken was not cooked well and it was hard. The muffin was not good and fresh neither. Waste of money

positive.text: Love, love, love Cooper's Hawk! Awesome food and amazing wine and wine tasting! Great for families, date night, or dinner/drinks with friends!
Great lunch restaurant, price is fair, service is good. Wine selection is good. Atmosphere is great, all in all a beautiful restaurant and great service a fair Price.

Not only are the COVID19 sanitation in force but the service is as always outstanding! They always let me know what deals are going on with my membership and even if I'm just there for the monthly bottle they still treat me with amazing friendly customer service. The BBQ pork chops are my fav.

negative.text: Sad place, ok wine and really bad food... ordered a Mediterranean salad with shrimp, it came full of pieces of white bread... what the heck??? The soy ginger Atlantic salmon was so dry, it stayed on the plate... mashed potatoes were ok... very disappointing

God forbid you reach out to them about a terrible experience. You'll never hear back after. Save your money and go to a better restaurant. It was our first time and last time. Service was terrible and food wasn't the greatest.

positive.text: Love it!! Besides having amazing ambience, the bartenders are the best and the food is mouth watering. The chopped salad is my personal favorite and the steaks of course are incredible. Great bar to take a date or hang out with friends. My favorite place in New Hope.

The crown jewel of New Hope! Marsha Brown's delicious dishes and incredible interior decor along with the southern charm hospitality is by far the best choice when dining out with friends and family! Fun bar with the latest greatest cocktails and the traditional elixirs as well! Beyond 5 star!!!! Sharon Slickis

Expensive but good. I love the pork chops they have theyre super good. But i really only go for the fresh baked bread! Some stuff is bizarre for those who dont know creole food but its a nice experience! The service is very very formal.

negative.text: Made reservations a month ago for Thanksgiving for 5:30. Been there before. Waited a half hour saw others who came in after us seated before us. One group had reservations at 6:15 and were seated at 6:00. We paid $10 for valet parking. It is also our anniversary. Very disappointing.

Came tot his place for lunch. There is dust hanging from the lamps, the food is subpar and had to waive down the waitress to get a refill on our waters. This place is overrated and I would never recommend or return to this restaurant.

positive.text: A must-try!! One of my all time favorite restaurants in Santa Barbara! I usually come for the AYCE buffet during lunch time by myself between classes. It's truly a great place. Everything is delicious and super affordable! The owners are super friendly and awesome! :)

I love this lunch buffet! I definitely go here at least once a week. The chicken tikka massala is great and all of the flavors are delicious. Also love the rice pudding! It's a nice place to sit and the staff are very welcoming and efficient. If you haven't tried Tamira, I absolutely recommend it!

My first time trying Indian food, and I truly loved it! I think that customer service was very nice, the team was very professional and welcoming. Restaurant was very clean and well organized. I will definitely come back and invite other friends! Price is very affordable and great for a quick meal.

negative.text: This place gave me diharrea the chicken smelled rotten the rice was hard and raw the Indian guy smelled like shit and his wife was looking at me funny the food is not good at all and the staff is rude thus Indian place is the worst ever I can't believe it there's mice running around and Yeah not cool broo
Not a good experience overall, Daal Makhni was salty and chicken tikka was not marinated at all.

positive.text: YUM!!!! Amazing steaks cooked to perfection!! Lobster was pure deliciousness . The salad that comes with the dinners was so good too!! Everything was amazing and we had Christopher wait on us at the bar area . He recommended a fabulous wine. Overall great place to eat. Would highly recommend.
Small place but very nice staff were very nice they open at 5pm good drinks food was great did not wait long for our orders great area will definitely be back and try the rest of their menu
By far best steak house ever! Great steaks, great value, reasonably priced wine, great service and just an overall fabulous place to eat... I promise you won't be disappointed!

negative.text: Decent food menu was ok. Probably wouldn't go back nothing special. Chefs there don't seem to be highly skilled had to send my steak back and I hate doing so.

Poor service from the very beginning. Hostess told us we could not get appetizers at the bar while waiting for a table. Glass of wine arrives with pieces of cork floating and bartender did not comp the drink.

positive.text: THIS PLACE IS ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! The true definition of a good ole hole in the wall!!! If you know New Orleans, you know the hole in the walls have the best food and best service!! This is now my FAVORITE BREAKFAST SPOT!! They have a huge menu and the items we had were great! I loved it!!! 20/10

Delicious! Delicious! Delicious! Bananas Foster French toast is a must! Costa Rican was yummy.. they did over cook my egg. But still yummy. Would have been better if I had that nice busted yolk! Will order again.. next time. Small place so expect to wait. Service good.
Super awesome shrimp and grits so well seasoned and had the best fresh pressed orange juice I've ever had! Great welcome to New Orleans and quick service.

negative.text: Went by this morning and unfortunately they were temporarily closed down due to COVID-19.

Absolutely my favorite brunch place in NOLA. The French toast is like no other. It's authentic French bread used and the shrimp and grits are to die for. Love this place but the magazine location only takes cash which can be annoying

positive.text: Delicious meat. Brisket is wonderful, S.O. likes their smoked turkey. Sides are good. Its always a little pricey, but not too much for what you get. Stl sweet sauce is great. I also really like their unique sodas. Cool place to eat.
Very good BBQ! I am super picky and this is a good place lots of sauce choices and unique soda choices. The staff was amazing! Everyone was very nice. I would go back again. Kids loved it!,
Best BBQ in town, staff is always super friendly and helpful, and I love that there is always a new side dish to try that always impresses.

negative.text: As always the food is delicious, but the service was terrible. I was rushed though out ordering my food and the older woman who was checking us out was SO rude and condescending.

There was a long greasy hair in my chicken. When I complained they brought me back the same tray. Didn't even both trying to disguise that it was the same food!! Went to the bathroom and one of the waitresses didn't wash her hands!! Never going back, this place is disgusting.

positive.text: Delicious and authentic Caribbean dishes, made with love and passion! We were warmly greeted by the owners when we arrived, and treated to a tasty and superbly spiced home-cooked meal. Great vibes, relaxed atmosphere, perfect for a romantic meal with your sweetie or a casual night with friends!!
Food was so AMAZING!!! Loved this adorable Family Owned joint. Staff was so sweet and welcoming.... felt great to support this local joint. Loved it!!

AMAZING! Some of the best Caribbean food I've had. Everything was perfectly seasoned and delicious. The oxtail was out of this world. Entire family loved every every dish. Service is also outstanding. André made us feel very welcome, as if we had been invited to his home. Will definitely come back here again!!

negative.text: Food was nasty, cold and just felt dirty. Could not recommend.
One word... phenomenal. Never have tried anything less than phenomenal! My fiancé is obsessed. This is the spot!!!

positive.text: I had an amazing experience at Billy G's in Kirkwood on Sunday! The restaurant was super packed but they were able to get our party of 2 to a table in a reasonable time! Our server was one of a kind and the food was absolutely amazing! I will definitely be coming back!
Great atmosphere! Love hanging outside and enjoying a few adult beverages. Awesome place to meet friends for happy hour or dinner.
Billy G's is good for happy hour but has an amazing Sunday brunch! The Bloody Mary and Mimosa Bar is awesome and the kids love the cinnamon bun! Warn Cinnamon Bun is HUGE!

negative.text: Terrible service today at the host stand. Told us they could not seat us a table in the shade. Then promptly seated groups behind us. In the shade. We get that it's tough COVID times. But when the hosts argue with customers that there's absolutely nothing they can do, it's a sign that the restaurant owner doesn't care.
Atmosphere is awesome & great drink selection but service was absolutely terrible, food took forever to get & was very average. Not worth the wait time.

positive.text: The most delicious vegan choices in Tucson! Best restaurant. Great service. Met a couple who chatted with me and I will meet them next week for dinner. The vegan mushroom salad and vegan pasta and garlic dishes were amazing! Be prepared to share with at least 4 people! These are huge servings!

Second time was just as delicious as the first amazing experience. Thank you Andrea fit taking such good care of my party of 6. There are so many good options and the specials are endless. I will come here every time I'm in Tucson.

First visit here. My wife & I agreed this was by far the best restaurant experience we've had in some time. The food was absolutely delicious, outstanding both in preparation and presentation. (A bit pricey, but portions were very generous.) Service was excellent. Nicely spaced patio seating alleviated covid concerns.

negative.text: I ate there before the shut down. Got violently ill. Called and talked with Steve , the owner. He was of no help. He passed me on to the manager , Michael. He was of no help either. I will never return there. They are not concerned about their customers health and safety . M

The service is by far the worst we've ever had! It's a very serious problem and management is unwilling to resolve it and could not care less about addressing any complaints. We will never go back and strongly recommend you stay away from this place.

positive.text: THEE BEST authentic Mexican restaurant in PA! Wonderful flavors great and friendly staff. Food is just like out of your best friends Mexican grandmas kitchen! Love....

My husband and I love this place!! We have tried several taco spots but nothing beats El Limon! The meat is so well seasoned! The red and green salsa/hot sauce is amazing! And free margaritas! The new location is amazing, great space!

Great spot !!! Had eaten at the other location a few years ago. Was happy to see they moved into a beautiful new space ! The nachos are awesome, the chorizo taco was even better. Everyone enjoyed their meals and the prices are very fair. Would def be back when in the area.

negative.text: Good food. RUDE service. I've been a customer of El Limon in conshohocken for years. They have above average authentic Mexican food, which is actually good. Despite their good food, I'm tired of the rude service from the older woman running the register/phones.

Food is cheap and that extends into the taste of the low quality meats they use. I've been here twice, but times same experience. Burrito and the steak fajitas...both bad. If you want cheap Mexican food just go down the street to Chipotle or Qdoba

positive.text: This little restaurant was a breath of fresh air! The bartender, David, was welcoming and fun! We had the best food and the environment was so fun and friendly due to David that we made some new friends! We will definitely be back!

Went there on Tuesday 10/13 evening for dinner shared a booth with people from NYC , being from Boston was amazing, food was great loved the cheese board and we all had Mac & cheese was good as well, waitress was wonderful.place was cool and cozy.may I recommend if there's a wait share a table or booth...
One of our favorite restaurants in Nashville. Soo good. Fun atmosphere. The staff was so much fun and so helpful in helping us pick the best thing to eat

negative.text: The fried fish didn't taste right. My stomach was upset all night. Just bad stuff. The chicken Mac and cheese was so hot my husband couldn't eat it. And he got the mild version.
Came here 2 hours before closing and they rejected me at the door "we are closed" when i knew they weren't closed for another 2 hours

positive.text: Dear India Kebab & Curry- How do you make such amazing mixed pickle? I have eaten it many times in many different places, but have never had any as delicious as the version you make. It is divine. I love the rest of your food as well. Thank you, A Happy, returning Customer

This restaurant has super great food. Their lunch buffet is my favorite; they have many different options (as well as many good vegetarian options as well). The service is great, and the restaurant is decorated nicely. Try the mango lassi drink- very yummy!

This place is great. The lunch buffet is the best deal and the food is amazing. Great selection of foods and it's great. I believe it's less than $10 for the buffet, which is a well worth it. I'm glad my buddy took me here because I have been back multiple times and will continue.

negative.text: Literally the worst place to eat. Service was very bad and we found hair in three of our orders. We told the manger and he argues with us because we didn't show him the hair we pulled out of our food. Do not eat here they have horrible service and they put hair in your food. Disgusting
I don't like the Resturant at all the reason is because the owner is so annoying he bothers you a lot and gives me as a lady a dirty look hate it

positive.text: Loved everything. Feta and hummus was so good. We loved the vibe and the drinks were also very tasty and aesthetically pleasing. Everything looked very well cared for and like they truly wanted you to love the taste. So amazing
We had such an awesome experience here. The food is so great! We ordered a bunch of different items to share and each items was better than the last. Great service, great food, great atmosphere!

Went in for Brunch and had the best experience EVER!! Maddie was our server and although we came in 30 minutes before they closed was SO accommodating and SO SWEET! Highly recommend her! They food was great as well and mimosas even better.

negative.text: Terrible. Awful Hip Hop music, blaring in your ears. Manager very confrontational. Over priced, and poor parking. Will never go here again!
I asked the chef to check if the chicken was raw and he said that there was no chance. I tried to eat around the cold chicken, but I lost my appetite looking at red pink chicken.

positive.text: What a fun place!!!! We had THE best margaritas! We also ordered empanadas. Each member of the wait staff had a favorite so we ordered steak, corn AND lamb. They were ALL delicious! The best part of this dining experience was the staff! What a fun bunch! They definitely started out our visit to Indy right!

I'd give Livery more stars if possible. I've had consistently excellent service, great cocktails, and fantastic food. On a mission to try everything on the menu because I'm confident it'd be superb. It's such a beautiful space too. Just everything you'd want without being stuffy or boring.
Excellence in everything. Pork belly tacos are amazing, ceviche is awesome, margaritas are fantastic. Service is great!

negative.text: Still go here often but will stop ordering the paella. It has been very salty the last two times we've gone. Very sad because it really was so good. But it's almost inedibly salty
Good appetizers and dessert menu. The empanadas were okayish. The service was very prompt.

positive.text: Amazing. Love you so much!!!! Best sushi bar ever!!! Tastes so good looks so good. Would recommend. Good service. Big smiles . Great food. Nice comfy seats!!! Fast!!! Wonderful thank you so much!!!

Best food and service anywhere! This place is da bomb! Super fresh and delicious sashimi and sushi, friendly staff and great drink specials. The ambiance is soothing. You are sure to have a wonderful and satisfying time. Enjoy!

Amazing food! Amazing atmosphere! Really cute fish in tanks and once again, amazing food. Our server Yun was so nice and provided amazing service. 100/10 this was some of the best sushi i've ever had.

negative.text: Not sure how many sushi choices in Tampa bay. We ordered the $32 sushi combo but I don't think it worthy that price from my personal perspectives. Based on the experiences in other sushi stores, the texture and the freshness are not that good.

31 dollars for sushi that looks like someone ate it in the back? Not crunchy salmon at all and I PICKED this up. Shame on you, shame. Do better and do not serve something to someone that will make them or their family sick.

positive.text: Amazing food with amazing views! Chowder has a great flavor, the slaw though was my favorite item. It's amazing the item you least expect to be good can be great. We ate here multiple meals and everything was great!

Great food!! Staff super friendly and really great vibes 100% recommend if you want to eat some good food and have some great drinks with a beautiful view this is the place i been here about 3 times and i will definitely keep coming back.

This is a great place to share with the people who love you as you are. Beautiful setup, great food. Our friends had the gator bites. Yum yum!! Ahi tuna, delish!!!!!! Fantastic service by Julia. Great drinks! Really the place to go and let go!

negative.text: Horrible service can't them anything without getting a laugh or a sarcastic comments. Wouldn't ever eat here again!!!!
Horrible rude management kicked my wife out for no reason and took her payed for glass of wine! Will never come back!!

positive.text: This place is very impressive! The food is so delicious and fresh. The service was excellent, and the view is beautiful! My friend and I sat at the bar, and Darian was so friendly and attentive. Great place for a nice date night!

Tonight was an amazing culinary experience. This was the best seafood restaurant I've experienced in years. The food was amazing, the staff was fabulous even the manager Steve came over to greet us and make sure we enjoyed our meal. Our server Debbie, was totally outstanding. I would highly recommend this restaurant.

Wonderful meal! Got the scallops and oysters Rockefeller. The best we've had in a while. Clean, great atmosphere, nice drinks and perfect service. Favorite restaurant at the moment. You outdid yourselves! Felt like I was on the east coast again.

negative.text: The brunch is a rip off if you don't drink alcohol. The all you can drink alcohol is the only reason it costs nearly $60 pp but that is no justification for the food itself. Extremely disappointed they don't cater to those who abstain from drinking
Went for Mother's Day and it was horrible. My moms food was cooked wrong and their was food on the floor

positive.text: We loved Ella's Americana Folk Art Cafe. Clean and a great crowd! I think no matter what you choose you will absolutely love their food, I especially loved their Ribs. All of the staff are super polite - you most certainly feel welcome and taken care of. Ella's Americana Folk Art Cafe...Check it out I say.

Love the ambience, love the food, love the staff. Ellas is a great little unique restaurant. Everything I've ordered has been great. Parking is complicated if you are new to the area. Decor is fun to browse through; eclectic- steam punk - hipster. Staff is friendly, and relatable.

You will really love Ella's Americana Folk Art Cafe. It's kinda the perfect location. Awesome menu items, Fried Chicken and Waffles was my choice and it was really amazing. Team is super pleasant and can help you with everything. Don't hesitate to order from here!

negative.text: The food ! No flavor very bland. The bread was cold in center and just old. I can't believe this place is still in business. Service was awful too.
Terrible. This place is dirty. The staff is very reluctant to help. I can't believe this place would be the way it is and still so highly rated on Yelp.

positive.text: ALWAYS THE BEST FOOD AND SERVICE IN ALL OF SANTA BARBARA!!! The seared scallops were amazing; the baked crab and artichoke dip amazing; the snapper and the lava cake all amazing! The Manager, Colin, is the most welcoming and efficient anywhere and our waiter Sean was perfect,too! THANK YOU!!!

Food and service where amazing. I had the clam chowder it was creamy, which I enjoyed. My husband had the grilled swordfish and said it was great. I highly recommend sitting upstairs - the view is awesome! Our drinks were great and the bartender was very educated on the menu

First time trying this place. It's right across from the ocean. They have patio sitting and you can bring your dog with you. We tried the charbroiled octopus was superb. The clams were also delicious. The salad super fresh staff was very efficient and friendly. We will definitely come back.

negative.text: A little disappointed. Our first meal while on vacation in SB. Calamari was caked with batter and was Chewy with visible freezer burn. Chips that came with the crab and artichoke dip were stale and bending. Got sick at 2 am after we got back to the room.
One of the worse service I have ever received , staff is distracted with other stuff talking to eachother about personal things cussing Just an all around waste of time . Food was just ok
